title.en: Canada could become first ‘associate member’ of the EU, von der Leyen suggests – Europe live
title.zh: 冯德莱恩建议加拿大可能成为欧盟的“准成员”——欧洲实时

summary.en: The European Commission president has suggested that Canada could become the first 'associate member' of the EU, aiming to elevate the partnership to the highest possible level. This move is driven by the priority of 'kickstarting Europe's economy,' by leveraging Canada's market, industries, and services. The EU also...
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会主席建议加拿大可能成为欧盟的第一个“准成员”，旨在将伙伴关系提升到可能的最高水平。此举的驱动力是优先“启动欧洲经济”，利用加拿大的市场、产业和服务。欧盟还寻求在明年年底前进一步改革和完成其单一市场，同时应对来自民族主义和外国干涉对民主构成的威胁。

body.en: European Commission president says the EU wants to ‘move the partnership with Canada to the highest level possible’ Von der Leyen says “kickstarting Europe’s economy is our number one priority,” as Europe needs to tap into its huge market, world class industries and services. She says its single market remains too fragmented and needs to reform further, with the aim of completing it by the end of next year. “ Do we want to rally around our European idea that together we can decide our own destiny? Or do we let our democracies be undermined by the proxies and puppets of authoritarians? Whether it is the ultra nationalist or the anti-European, whether it’s Russian interference or disinformation, the names may be different, but their goal is the same. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧盟委员会主席表示，欧盟希望“将与加拿大的伙伴关系提升到尽可能高的水平”，冯德莱恩表示，“启动欧洲经济是我们的首要任务”，因为欧洲需要利用其巨大的市场、世界一流的工业和服务。她表示，其单一市场仍然过于分散，需要进一步改革，目标是在明年年底前完成改革。 “我们是否想团结在我们的欧洲理念周围，共同决定我们自己的命运？还是让我们的民主国家被独裁者的代理人和傀儡所破坏？无论是极端民族主义者还是反欧洲主义者，无论是俄罗斯的干涉还是虚假信息，名称可能不同，但他们的目标是相同的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Europe seeks to revitalize its economy through a deepened partnership with Canada, the ambition to 'kickstart' growth and reform markets reflects a significant human endeavor. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. This principle encourages leaders and nations to pursue economic goals with...
reflection.zh: 当欧洲寻求通过与加拿大的深化伙伴关系来振兴经济时，‘启动’增长和改革市场的雄心反映了一项重大人类事业。 箴言 16:3 提醒我们要将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟，相信他会成就。这一原则鼓励领导者和国家勤奋地追求经济目标，同时承认更高的目标并为他们的努力寻求神圣的指导。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘It’s how Jean does business’: Fugitive developer left Jeremy Greenwood ‘high and dry’, Icac hears
title.zh: “这就是让·做生意的方式”：逃犯开发商让杰里米·格林伍德“孤立无援”，Icac听证会称

summary.en: Jeremy Greenwood denies that invoices for almost $1m sent in a single day in September 2021 were ‘bogus accounts’ to cover up political donations. A Liberal factional figure has been left “high and dry” by fugitive property developer Jean Nassif, but did not chase him for payments because “it’s how Jean does...

The situation leaves individuals like Jeremy Greenwood feeling abandoned, with a sense that such practices are simply 'how business is done.' This raises questions about integrity and...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

title.en: European Union opens door for Canada to become first associate member
title.zh: 欧盟为加拿大成为首个准成员国敞开大门

summary.en: The European Commission president has proposed that Canada could become the EU's first associate member. This overture follows US trade policies that have prompted Canada to seek stronger ties with Europe and reduce its reliance on the US economy.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会主席提议加拿大可以成为欧盟的首个准成员国。这一提议是在美国贸易政策促使加拿大寻求与欧洲建立更紧密联系并减少对美国经济依赖的背景下提出的。

body.en: Commission president says partnership will create ‘common prosperity’ based on shared democratic values Europe live – latest updates The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, told the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, on Wednesday that she wants to open the door for his country to become the EU’s first associate member. The overture comes as Trump’s tariffs and repeated talk of making Canada the 51st state have pushed Ottawa to seek closer economic and security ties with Europe. Carney has called for a “unique alliance” with the EU as Canada seeks to reduce its heavy dependence on US trade. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧盟委员会主席表示，伙伴关系将在共同民主价值观的基础上创造“共同繁荣”这一提议出台之际，特朗普的关税政策和一再谈论让加拿大成为第 51 个国家，促使渥太华寻求与欧洲建立更紧密的经济和安全关系。卡尼呼吁与欧盟建立“独特的联盟”，因为加拿大寻求减少对美国贸易的严重依赖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world of shifting alliances and economic pressures, nations often seek new partnerships. The desire for 'common prosperity' and 'unique alliances' speaks to the human need for security and mutual benefit. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is skillful and abundant guidance, there is victory and safety, and in the multitude of counselors there...
reflection.zh: 在一个联盟关系不断变化、经济压力重重的世界里，国家常常寻求新的伙伴关系。“共同繁荣”和“独特联盟”的愿望，体现了人类对安全和互利的需要。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“谋士多，人便得胜；不听劝谏，国便败亡。”愿列国领袖在处理这些复杂国际关系时，寻求明智的咨询。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
title.zh: 沙特称在麦加南部击落胡塞无人机

summary.en: Saudi Arabia claims it intercepted a Houthi drone south of Mecca, an accusation the Houthis deny, calling it 'fabrications and lies' after the Saudi-led coalition labeled the alleged act 'disgraceful'.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯声称在麦加南部拦截了一架胡塞无人机，胡塞武装否认了这一指控，称其为“捏造和谎言”，此前沙特领导的联军称此举为“可耻的行为”。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of the Islamic holy city of Mecca on Tuesday evening, according to the spokesman of the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen.

Turki al-Maliki said the targeting of Mecca, which is the home of Islam's most sacred shrine and the focal point of the Hajj pilgrimage, was a "disgraceful act".

The 57-nation Organisation of Islamic Cooperation said attacks on Mecca and Medina province, where Islam's second holiest shrine is located, constituted an "unacceptable and intolerable transgression".

But the Houthis, an Iran-backed armed group that controls much of western Yemen, denied targeting Mecca and accused Saudi Arabia of "fabrications and lies".

"There is no threat whatsoever from Yemen to the holy sites. Our operations target their oil facilities and military bases, and are far removed from the holy places," military spokesman Yahya Sarea said.

Sarea added that the Houthis had launched drones and missiles at Saudi Arabia in retaliation for more than 450 Saudi air strikes on their territory over the past week.

There was no immediate response from the Saudi-led coalition, but Maj Gen Maliki did say that its forces would "not hesitate to take the necessary and deterrent measures against the terrorist Houthi militia and its hostile and terrorist behaviour".

On Tuesday, Saudi authorities issued a series of brief security alerts for incoming projectiles in a number of western areas, including Mecca and Jeddah, the kingdom's second largest city.

Meanwhile, the US embassy in Saudi Arabia issued a "reconsider travel" advisory, warning that Houthi attacks had targeted cities, infrastructure, airports, military bases, diplomatic facilities and energy facilities.

The Houthis have recently seized control of large swathes of Yemen's Red Sea coast from Saudi-backed pro-government forces.

Last week, they captured the strategic port city of Mokha and Perim Island in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the southern gateway to a key shipping route that links Asia and Europe via the Red Sea and the Suez canal.

The Houthis said they posed no threat to international shipping but reiterated that they would target vessels from Saudi Arabia, which has relied on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war with Iran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.

At the same time, Saudi Arabia's key East-West Pipeline, which was being used to transfer crude oil from the Gulf to the Red Sea port of Yanbu, had to be closed after it was badly damaged in a strike that the kingdom blamed on Iran-backed militias in Iraq.

Some experts have said it could take more than a month to repair the pipeline, but US Energy Secretary Chris Wright predicted on Tuesday that oil should be flowing through it within days.

body.zh: 沙特领导的也门联军发言人表示，沙特阿拉伯周二晚上在伊斯兰圣城麦加以南拦截并摧毁了一架胡塞武装无人机。 图尔基·马利基表示，针对伊斯兰教最神圣的圣地麦加和朝觐焦点的麦加的袭击是一种“可耻的行为”。 由 57 个国家组成的伊斯兰合作组织表示，对伊斯兰教第二圣地所在地麦加和麦地那省的袭击构成了“不可接受和无法容忍的违法行为”。 但控制也门西部大部分地区的伊朗支持的武装组织胡塞武装否认以麦加为目标，并指责沙特阿拉伯“捏造和谎言”。 军方发言人叶海亚·萨雷亚（Yahya Sarea）表示：“也门对圣地不存在任何威胁。我们的行动针对他们的石油设施和军事基地，并且远离圣地。” 萨雷亚补充说，胡塞武装向沙特阿拉伯发射了无人机和导弹，以报复沙特过去一周对其领土进行的 450 多次空袭。 沙特领导的联军没有立即做出回应，但马利基少将确实表示，其部队将“毫不犹豫地对胡塞武装民兵及其敌对和恐怖行为采取必要的威慑措施”。 周二，沙特当局针对包括麦加和沙特第二大城市吉达在内的一些西部地区的来袭弹丸发布了一系列简短的安全警报。 与此同时，美国驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆发布了“重新考虑旅行”的建议，警告胡塞武装的袭击目标是城市、基础设施、机场、军事基地、外交设施和能源设施。 胡塞武装最近从沙特支持的亲政府部队手中夺取了也门红海沿岸大片地区的控制权。 上周，他们占领了曼德海峡的战略港口城市莫卡和佩里姆岛，这里是通过红海和苏伊士运河连接亚洲和欧洲的重要航运路线的南大门。 胡塞武装表示，他们对国际航运不构成威胁，但重申他们的目标是来自沙特阿拉伯的船只。自从美国和以色列与伊朗的战争有效关闭了海湾的霍尔木兹海峡以来，沙特阿拉伯一直依赖红海进行石油出口。 与此同时，沙特阿拉伯重要的东西向管道——该管道用于将原油从海湾输送到红海延布港——在一次袭击中严重受损，该管道遭到严重破坏，该管道被沙特归咎于伊朗支持的伊拉克民兵组织。 一些专家表示，修复该管道可能需要一个多月的时间，但美国能源部长克里斯·赖特周二预测，石油应该会在几天内流经该管道。 沙特...

reflection.en: The news of a drone incident near Mecca, met with accusations and denials, speaks to the ongoing cycle of conflict in the region. In such moments, the call to overcome evil with good, rather than mirroring aggression, remains a profound challenge for all parties involved.
reflection.zh: 关于麦加附近发生无人机事件的消息，伴随着指责和否认，反映了该地区持续的冲突循环。在这样的时刻，以善胜恶，而非以攻击回应攻击，仍然是所有相关方面临的深刻挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
title.zh: 埃德·希兰美国巡演所有助演嘉宾退出，此前麦克尔莫尔被取消资格

summary.en: All remaining support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour have withdrawn following rapper Macklemore's removal from the lineup due to pro-Palestinian statements made on stage. Artists like Finneas cited the need to speak up for the oppressed, with others also announcing their departure.
summary.zh: 埃德·希兰美国巡演中所有剩余的助演嘉宾已退出，此前说唱歌手麦克尔莫尔因在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而被取消资格。包括菲尼亚斯在内的艺术家们表示，必须为受压迫者发声，其他艺人也宣布退出。

body.en:
All of the remaining support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour have quit, after the rapper Macklemore was dropped from the line-up for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

Among them were Finneas, the brother of pop star Billie Eilish, who said in a statement: "Artists must not be silenced when they speak up for the oppressed."

Irish singer-songwriter Aaron Rowe and Danish band Lukas Graham also announced their departure. Irish folk band Beoga, who perform with Sheeran on stage every night, dropped out too.

The announcements came hours after Sheeran said he would not be drawn into a public debate over Gaza, and stressed he was not responsible for Macklemore being removed from the tour.

"Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter's decision, it was not mine," Sheeran said on Instagram.

"I would never let down the fans who had made plans, nor would I abandon the touring crew and the other support acts and musicians who rely on me for work and to make a living."

Sheeran is set to next perform at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia on Saturday. His Loop tour website has not been updated, and Graham and Rowe are still listed as special guests.

Earlier this month, Macklemore - real name Benjamin Haggerty - called for a "free Palestine" and showed images of devastation in Gaza during two concerts in New Jersey.

His comments drew criticism from Jewish groups, after which some venues put pressure on the tour promoters to drop him from the tour.

In his statement , external , Sheeran said he had spoken to the venues "at length all week to try and build a bridge" - but the promoters, Messina Touring Group, had ultimately pulled the plug.

While the star said he was “appalled by the conflict between Israel and Palestine" and that the "suffering and pain caused on both sides is a human tragedy", he also attempted to explain his decision to keep political issues at arm’s length.

"I am not complicit," he wrote. "I have my personal views on this devastating conflict. Just because I choose not to speak publicly, it doesn't mean I don't have them, and it doesn't mean I don't care.

He continued: "There is a reason I do not use my professional platform for politics - my audience includes young people, often children, of all backgrounds.

"Those who come to my shows do not expect a political forum. I respect Macklemore's strength of purpose to stand up and shout for what he believes.

"I choose to use my fame and platform to be a place of safety and sanctuary, to maintain diplomacy and keep conversations open, not closed. If we only focus on shouting the loudest, nothing will ever change. There are different approaches to being an advocate for change."

body.zh: 在说唱歌手麦克勒莫尔因在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而被除名后，艾德·希兰美国巡演的所有剩余支持活动都已退出。 其中包括流行歌星比莉·艾利什的兄弟芬尼斯，他在一份声明中表示：“当艺术家为受压迫者发声时，他们绝不能被压制。” 爱尔兰创作歌手亚伦·罗和丹麦乐队卢卡斯·格雷厄姆也宣布离开。每晚与希兰一起在舞台上表演的爱尔兰民谣乐队 Beoga 也退出了。 在宣布这一消息的几个小时前，希兰表示他不会卷入有关加沙问题的公开辩论，并强调他对麦克莫尔被排除在巡回演出之外不承担任何责任。 希兰在 Instagram 上表示：“麦克莫尔退出巡演是主办方的决定，不是我的决定。” “我永远不会让已经制定计划的歌迷失望，我也不会放弃巡演团队和其他支持我的艺人和音乐家，他们依靠我工作和谋生。” 本月早些时候，麦克莫尔（真名本杰明·哈格蒂）呼吁建立一个“自由的巴勒斯坦”，并在新泽西州的两场音乐会上展示了加沙遭受破坏的图像。 他的言论引起了犹太团体的批评，之后一些场馆向巡演发起人施压，要求他退出巡演。 希兰在对外声明中表示，他“整个星期都与场馆进行了长时间的交谈，试图建造一座桥梁”，但主办方墨西拿旅游集团最终取消了这一计划。 虽然这位明星表示，他“对以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的冲突感到震惊”，并且“双方造成的苦难和痛苦是一场人类悲剧”，但他也试图解释自己与政治问题保持距离的决定。 “我不是同谋，”他写道。 “我对这场毁灭性的冲突有我个人的看法。仅仅因为我选择不公开发言，并不意味着我没有这些看法，也不意味着我不在乎。 他继续说道：“我不利用我的专业平台参与政治是有原因的——我的受众包括各种背景的年轻人，通常是儿童。 “那些来观看我的演出的人并不期望看到一个政治论坛。我尊重麦克莫尔站起来并为他的信念大声疾呼的坚定决心。 “我选择利用我的名誉和平台成为一个安全和避难所，维持外交并保持对话开放，而不是封闭。如果我们只专注于大声喊叫，什么都不会改变。倡导变革有不同的方法。” 希兰补充说，“就像我所有的支持行为一样”，麦克莫尔被允许选择自己的演出名单。 如果该声明的目的是安抚他的粉丝和其他艺术家，那么它似乎产生了相反的效果。 卢卡斯·格雷厄姆在 Instagram 上写道：“我们应该能够……

reflection.en: When artists use their platform to speak for those without a voice, they echo a timeless call to defend the oppressed. The withdrawal of multiple acts from Ed Sheeran's tour, in solidarity with Macklemore's pro-Palestinian statements, highlights the courage it takes to stand with the marginalized, even at personal cost. reflection.zh: 当艺术家利用他们的平台为无声者发声时，他们呼应了为受压迫者辩护的永恒呼召。多个助演团体退出埃德·希兰的巡演，声援麦克尔莫尔的亲巴勒斯坦言论，这凸显了即使付出个人代价也要与边缘化群体站在一起的勇气。这一行动反映了圣经中为弱势群体争取权益的命令。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Lisa Nandy brands Musk’s X a ‘disgrace’ as she pledges crackdown on social media doxxing – UK politics live
title.zh: 莉萨·南迪抨击马斯克的X是“耻辱”，并承诺打击社交媒体的起底行为——英国政治直播

summary.en: Culture secretary says X ‘didn’t even bother to turn up’ to meeting about abuse, intimidation and doxxing on social media. An Oxfordshire village which could house more than 1,000 asylum seekers has voted overwhelmingly to become an independent state in a symbolic “referendum”.
summary.zh: 文化大臣表示，X“甚至没有 bother to turn up”（出席）关于社交媒体上的虐待、恐吓和起底行为的会议。一个可能容纳1000多名寻求庇护者的牛津郡村庄，在一场象征性的“公投”中以压倒性多数投票决定成为一个独立国家。

body.en: Culture secretary says X ‘didn’t even bother to turn up’ to meeting about abuse, intimidation and doxxing on social media An Oxfordshire village which could house more than 1,000 asylum seekers has voted overwhelmingly to become an independent state in a symbolic “referendum” , the Press Association reports. PA says: The people of Piddington have voted to secede from the UK after the government announced plans to house 1,256 male asylum seekers at a nearby former military base. Some 285 villagers backed “independence”, with a turnout of nearly 92%. Continue reading...
body.zh: 文化大臣表示，X “甚至懒得出席”有关社交媒体上的虐待、恐吓和人肉搜索问题的会议 据新闻协会报道，牛津郡一个可容纳 1000 多名寻求庇护者的村庄在一次象征性的“公投”中以压倒性多数投票决定成为一个独立国家。 PA 表示：在政府宣布计划在附近的前军事基地安置 1,256 名男性寻求庇护者后，皮丁顿人民投票决定脱离英国。约有285名村民支持“独立”，投票率接近92%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In response to plans to house asylum seekers, a village in Oxfordshire has symbolically voted for independence. This action, while symbolic, raises questions about how communities engage with national decisions affecting vulnerable populations. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle relevant to ensuring...
reflection.zh: 为应对安置寻求庇护者的计划，牛津郡的一个村庄象征性地投票决定独立。这一行动虽然象征性，但引发了关于社区如何参与影响弱势群体的国家决策的问题。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能开口的人代求，为所有孤儿的案件审判伸冤”，这一原则与确保所有人的尊严和权利息息相关，包括寻求庇护者。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Mayors and other local leaders could be given powers to oversee water firms
title.zh: 市长和其他地方领导人可能被赋予监督水务公司的权力

summary.en: The UK government is considering plans to give mayors and other local politicians powers to oversee water companies, allowing them input on company spending and the ability to hold executives accountable for issues like bills and sewage discharges. This move aims to bring utilities under greater public control.
summary.zh: 英国政府正在考虑一项计划，赋予市长和其他地方政界人士监督水务公司的权力，让他们能够就公司支出发表意见，并追究高管在账单和污水排放等问题上的责任。此举旨在使公用事业受到更大的公众控制。

body.en: Move would mean some input on companies’ spending and holding bosses to account over bills and sewage discharges Mayors and other local politicians could be given powers to oversee water companies under plans being considered by the UK government to bring utilities under greater public control. Local leaders would have the power to direct some parts of water companies’ spending and hold bosses to account over bills and sewage discharges as part of the proposals. Continue reading...
body.zh: 此举将意味着对公司的支出进行一些投入，并让老板对账单和污水排放负责。根据英国政府正在考虑的计划，市长和其他地方政界人士可能会被赋予监督自来水公司的权力，以将公用事业置于更大的公共控制之下。作为提案的一部分，地方领导人将有权指导自来水公司的部分支出，并要求老板对账单和污水排放负责。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of persistent issues like sewage discharges and rising bills, the UK government is exploring ways to empower local leaders to hold water companies accountable. This echoes the ancient call for rulers to "execute justice and righteousness" (Jeremiah 22:3), ensuring that those in positions of power serve the public good and are answerable for...
reflection.zh: 面对持续存在的污水排放和账单上涨等问题，英国政府正在探索赋予地方领导人问责水务公司的方法。这呼应了古代对统治者“施行公平和公义”（耶利米书 22:3）的要求，确保掌权者服务于公众利益并对其管理负责。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: At least 12 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
title.zh: 加沙一栋受损建筑倒塌至少12人死亡

summary.en: At least 12 people, including children, have been killed and dozens are missing after a war-damaged building collapsed in Gaza City. The building, which housed 10 families, was reportedly unsafe.
summary.zh: 据当地救援队称，加沙地带一栋受战争损毁的建筑倒塌，造成至少12人死亡，其中包括儿童，另有数十人失踪。据报道，这栋有多户家庭居住的建筑并不安全。

body.en:
At least 12 people have been killed, including children, and dozens are missing after a war-damaged building collapsed in the Gaza Strip, according to local rescue teams.

Video footage shows the search for bodies and survivors continuing in the rubble of the multi-storey building in the Tal al-Hawa area of Gaza City, its floors sandwiched together.

Locals said 10 families had been living in the apartments despite warnings that they were unsafe.

Members of the Hamas-run Civil Defence rescue service said they had initially been working with "empty hands" due to tight Israeli restrictions on equipment allowed into Gaza. However, they have since been able to borrow some heavy machinery.

On Tuesday, Israeli air strikes in Gaza killed at least five Palestinians, including two children and a Hamas commander, according to health officials and Hamas sources.

The Israeli military said it killed a Hamas commander in southern Gaza and another fighter in the north. In both cases, a child was also reportedly killed.

Separately, the British charity Medical Aid for Palestinians said that a patient was killed by an Israeli drone at a health centre it supports in Jabalia in northern Gaza.
body.zh: 据当地救援队称，加沙地带一栋受战争破坏的建筑倒塌，造成至少 12 人死亡，其中包括儿童，数十人失踪。 视频片段显示，在加沙城塔尔哈瓦地区一栋多层建筑的废墟中继续搜寻尸体和幸存者，该建筑的地板夹在一起。 当地人称，尽管有警告称这些公寓不安全，但仍有 10 个家庭住在这些公寓里。 哈马斯民防救援部门的成员表示，由于以色列对进入加沙的设备实行严格限制，他们最初是“空着手”开展工作。不过，他们已经能够借到一些重型机械了。 据卫生官员和哈马斯消息人士称，周二，以色列对加沙的空袭造成至少五名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括两名儿童和一名哈马斯指挥官。 以色列军方表示，在加沙南部打死了一名哈马斯指挥官，在北部打死了另一名战士。据报道，在这两起案件中，还有一名儿童被杀。 另外，英国慈善机构巴勒斯坦人医疗援助组织表示，在其支持的加沙北部贾巴利亚的一家医疗中心，一名患者被以色列无人机杀死。

reflection.en: In Gaza, the rubble of a collapsed building holds the weight of unimaginable loss, with 12 lives, including children, extinguished and families missing. This tragedy echoes the deep human yearning for a world free from such sorrow. Revelation 21:4 offers a vision of hope, promising a future where Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and death, mourning, and...
reflection.zh: 在加沙，倒塌建筑的废墟承载着难以想象的悲痛，12条生命（包括儿童）消逝，家园失散。这一悲剧呼应了人类对摆脱此类苦难世界的深切渴望。《启示录》21:4 带来了希望的异象，应许未来雅伟将擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡、悲哀、哭号和痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Kosovo ex-president Thaci faces Hague war crimes verdict
title.zh: 科索沃前总统塔奇面临海牙战争罪判决

summary.en: A tribunal will rule if Hashim Thaci, a former commander of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), committed war crimes during the war of independence with Serbia.
summary.zh: 一个法庭将裁定科索沃解放军（KLA）前指挥官哈希姆·塔奇在科索沃独立战争期间是否犯下战争罪。

body.en:
A tribunal will rule if Hashim Thaci, a former commander of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), committed war crimes during the war of independence with Serbia.

A Kosovo war crimes tribunal on Wednesday will hand down its ruling in a three-year trial of former President Hashim Thaci and several commanders of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) for war crimes and crimes against humanity allegedly committed during the 1998-1999 independence war with Serbia.

Thaci, a former KLA political leader, and former high-ranking KLA guerrillas Jakup Krasniqi, Rexhep Selimi and Kadri Veseli, have all pleaded not guilty to multiple counts including murder, torture and persecution.

Prosecutors have said KLA forces killed more than 100 political opponents and perceived collaborators with Serbian security forces during and just after the Kosovo war.

This included prisoners held at KLA facilities in Kosovo and Albania, along with politically motivated murders of Serb, Albanian and Roma civilians.

The defense has argued that the senior KLA figures could not control or be held responsible for such acts, as the group lacked a strict command structure.

Lawyers have argued there is no direct evidence linking Thaci's command to any of the alleged crimes. 

The accused are revered as national heroes in Kosovo , and the KLA and Thaci are seen as symbols of the independence movement. Thaci remained a central political figure after the war and was instrumental in Kosovo's 2008 declaration of independence from Serbia .

The verdict in The Hague is being livestreamed in the Kosovo capital, Pristina, where thousands of Thaci and KLA supporters are expected to gather. This follows rallies over the weekend that drew tens of thousands calling for the men's acquittal. A huge digital clock is counting down to the verdicts on Wednesday.

"Our war was just, a war of liberation," Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti said ahead of the verdict.

"We believe and hope … that the KLA leaders will return free to their country and to their families," he added.

After being indicted in 2020, Thaci resigned as president and has been detained in The Hague since then.

Throughout the proceedings, prosecutors have tried to distinguish between Kosovo's struggle for independence from Serbia and the alleged crimes committed by the men on trial.

The tribunal responsible for prosecuting the case, the Kosovo Specialist Chambers (KSC), was set up in 2016 after earlier cases in Kosovo failed due to alleged political interference and witness intimidation.

Although based in The Hague, and staffed by international judges, the KSC was established under Kosovo law specifically to prosecute alleged KLA war crimes.

Nevertheless, the KSC remains deeply unpopular in Kosovo. Out of...
body.zh: 如果科索沃解放军（KLA）前指挥官哈希姆·塔奇（Hashim Thaci）在与塞尔维亚的独立战争期间犯下战争罪，法庭将做出裁决。 周三，科索沃战争罪法庭将对前总统哈希姆·塔奇和科索沃解放军（KLA）几名指挥官进行为期三年的审判，指控他们在 1998-1999 年与塞尔维亚的独立战争期间犯下战争罪和危害人类罪。 科索沃解放军前政治领导人塔奇以及科索沃解放军前高级游击队员贾库普·克拉斯尼奇 (Jakup Krasniqi)、雷杰普·塞利米 (Rexhep Selimi) 和卡德里·维塞利 (Kadri Veseli) 均对谋杀、酷刑和迫害等多项罪名表示不认罪。 检察官表示，科索沃解放军部队在科索沃战争期间和战争结束后杀害了 100 多名政治对手和被认为与塞尔维亚安全部队合作的人。 其中包括关押在科索沃和阿尔巴尼亚科索沃解放军设施中的囚犯，以及出于政治动机对塞尔维亚、阿尔巴尼亚和罗姆平民的谋杀。 辩方辩称，科索沃解放军高级官员无法控制此类行为，也无法对此类行为负责，因为该组织缺乏严格的指挥结构。 律师辩称，没有直接证据表明塔奇的指挥与任何涉嫌的犯罪行为有关。 被告在科索沃被尊为民族英雄，科索沃解放军和塔奇被视为独立运动的象征。 战后，塔奇仍然是一位核心政治人物，并在科索沃 2008 年宣布脱离塞尔维亚独立的过程中发挥了重要作用。 海牙的判决正在科索沃首都普里什蒂纳进行直播，预计数千名塔奇和科索沃解放军的支持者将聚集在那里。在此之前，周末举行了集会，吸引了数万人呼吁无罪释放。一个巨大的数字时钟正在对周三的判决进行倒计时。 科索沃总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂在判决前表示：“我们的战争是正义的，是一场解放战争。” 他补充说：“我们相信并希望……科索沃解放军领导人将自由返回自己的国家和家人身边。” 2020年被起诉后，塔奇辞去了总统职务，此后一直被拘留在海牙。 在整个诉讼过程中，检察官试图区分科索沃争取从塞尔维亚独立的斗争和受审男子涉嫌犯下的罪行。 负责起诉此案的法庭科索沃特别分庭 (KSC) 于 2016 年成立，此前科索沃的早期案件因涉嫌政治干预和证人恐吓而失败。 尽管科索沃委员会总部设在海牙，并由国际法官组成，但该委员会是根据科索沃法律设立的，专门起诉科索沃解放军涉嫌的战争罪。 尽管如此，科索沃安全委员会在科索沃仍然非常不受欢迎。出于...

reflection.en: The verdict for Hashim Thaci and other former KLA commanders will bring a measure of accountability for alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity. This moment calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless call: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with Yahweh. May this process, however difficult, contribute to a more just and merciful future.
reflection.zh: 哈希姆·塔奇和其他前科索沃解放军指挥官的判决将为所谓的战争罪和危害人类罪带来一定程度的问责。这一时刻让人想起先知弥迦永恒的呼召：行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿这个过程，无论多么艰难，都能为更加公正和充满怜悯的未来做出贡献。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中国和俄罗斯的愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a 'battlefield'. The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia, who are warning against the idea of space becoming a...
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒，它们警告太空可能成为“战场”。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

Russia, meanwhile, "views space as a...
body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The US confirmation of deploying weapons in space, and the resulting alarm from Russia and China, highlights a dangerous escalation. This move risks turning the frontier of space into a domain of conflict, rather than a shared realm for peaceful exploration and benefit. The prophetic vision of Isaiah calls for a different path, where instruments of war are...
reflection.zh: 美国证实已在太空部署武器，并因此引发俄罗斯和中国的警报，这凸显了危险的升级。此举有将太空前沿变成冲突领域的风险，而不是将其作为和平探索和造福的共享领域。以赛亚的先知异象呼唤另一条道路，即战争的工具被转化为和平的工具，这与当前的轨迹形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Three killed after LA news helicopter crashes while covering deadly bus collision
title.zh: 新闻直升机在报道致命公交车事故时坠毁，造成三人死亡

summary.en: A news helicopter belonging to NBCLA crashed in suburban Los Angeles while reporting on a fatal bus collision, resulting in the deaths of the two crew members on board and one person on the ground. The helicopter went down shortly before 7 PM local time.
summary.zh: 一架隶属于NBCLA的新闻直升机在洛杉矶郊区坠毁，当时它正在报道一起致命的公交车相撞事故。事故造成机上两名机组人员和地面上一人死亡。直升机于当地时间晚上7点前不久坠落。

body.en:
Three people have died and two others taken to hospital after a news helicopter crashed in suburban Los Angeles, fire authorities in the city have said.

NBC Los Angeles confirmed the helicopter was its NewsChopper4, which also operated for Telemundo 52, and was in the area on Tuesday reporting on a deadly bus crash.

The station's hosts said both people on the helicopter, who were "valued friends and colleagues" had died, naming them as Eliana Moreno and George Marciniw.

They said the third victim was on the ground at the time of the crash, but did not name them.

The aircraft went down just before 19:00 local time (01:00 BST) between two commercial buildings in the Chatsworth neighbourhood, a Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) spokesperson told the BBC.

Fire from the crash spread to four vehicles and two storage containers, and more than 70 firefighters were deployed to the scene, the LAFD added.

During emotional live coverage on NBC4, veteran news anchor Colleen Williams confirmed it was the local news station's helicopter that crashed.

"We knew it was a news chopper. We knew we'd lost contact with our people out there, and we've just received confirmation," Williams said.

Earlier, LAFD Captain Branden Silverman told the local affiliate of the BBC's US partner CBS: "We do have one confirmed patient that seemed to be outside of the helicopter when it crashed.

Several news helicopters were in the area at the time of the incident reporting on a bus crash.

Earlier in the day, two people were killed and six others were injured after an SUV crashed into a city bus in Chatsworth, BBC's US partner CBS reported.

LAPD's Central Division posted on X that it extended "thoughts and prayers to the family, friends and colleagues of KNBC 4, Los Angeles".

Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass wrote on X she was "absolutely devastated by the loss of life in Chatsworth tonight".

"My heart is with the families and loved ones of those we lost in the tragic bus collision and helicopter crash," she added.

California Governor Gavin Newsom wrote on X that "our hearts are with the victims and families of tonight's devastating Metro bus and helicopter crashes in Chatsworth, and with the entire NBC4 family".

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) will lead the investigation into the incident.
body.zh: 洛杉矶消防部门表示，一架新闻直升机在洛杉矶郊区坠毁，造成三人死亡，两人被送往医院。 NBC Los Angeles 证实这架直升机是其 NewsChopper4，该直升机也为 Telemundo 52 运营，并于周二在该地区报道了一起致命的巴士事故。 该电视台的主持人表示，直升机上的两人都是“重要的朋友和同事”，他们都已经死亡，他们的名字是埃利安娜·莫雷诺和乔治·马尔西尼。 他们说，坠机时第三名受害者就在地上，但没有透露他们的名字。 洛杉矶消防局 (LAFD) 发言人告诉 BBC，这架飞机于当地时间 19:00（英国夏令时 01:00）之前在查茨沃斯 (Chatsworth) 街区的两座商业建筑之间坠毁。 洛杉矶消防局补充说，事故引发的大火蔓延到四辆车和两个储物柜，现场部署了 70 多名消防员。 在 NBC4 的激动人心的现场报道中，资深新闻主播科琳·威廉姆斯证实坠毁的是当地新闻台的直升机。 “我们知道这是一架新闻直升机。我们知道我们与外面的人失去了联系，而且我们刚刚收到了确认，”威廉姆斯说。 早些时候，洛杉矶消防局队长布兰登·西尔弗曼（Branden Silverman）告诉英国广播公司（BBC）美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）当地分支机构：“我们确实有一名确诊患者，直升机坠毁时他似乎在直升机外面。 事件发生时，几架新闻直升机正在该地区报道一起公共汽车事故。 据英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司报道，当天早些时候，一辆SUV在查茨沃斯撞上一辆城市公交车，造成两人死亡、六人受伤。 洛杉矶警察局中央部门在 X 上发帖表示，“向洛杉矶 KNBC 4 的家人、朋友和同事表示哀悼和祈祷”。 洛杉矶市长凯伦·巴斯 (Karen Bass) 在 X 上写道，她“对今晚查茨沃斯的生命损失感到非常震惊”。 她补充说：“我的心与我们在悲惨的巴士相撞和直升机失事中丧生的人们的家人和亲人同在。” 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 在 X 上写道，“我们的心与今晚查茨沃斯发生的毁灭性地铁巴士和直升机坠毁事件的受害者和家人以及整个 NBC4 家庭同在”。 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）将领导对此事件的调查。

reflection.en: Tragedy struck twice in Los Angeles when a news helicopter crashed while covering a fatal bus collision, claiming three lives. In moments of profound loss, we are reminded of the ultimate hope found in Revelation 21:4, which speaks of a future where 'death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore.'
reflection.zh: 洛杉矶发生双重悲剧，一架新闻直升机在报道一起致命的公交车事故时坠毁，夺走了三条生命。在这些深切哀痛的时刻，我们被提醒在启示录21:4中找到的终极盼望，经上说‘不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭泣、疼痛。’

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
title.zh: 英伟达CEO称AI“不需要新法律” 安全担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence (AI) does not require new laws, even as concerns about its potential threats to humanity grow. He believes that AI companies themselves should decide when to release new versions of the technology, arguing against a perceived trade-off between innovation...
summary.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，尽管对人工智能（AI）可能对人类构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，但人工智能并不需要新的法律。他认为人工智能公司本身应该决定何时发布新版本技术，并反对在创新速度和产品安全之间做出“虚假选择”。这一立场与一些业内人士的担忧形成对比，他们担心人工智能可能带来生存风险。

body.en:
The boss of ChatGPT-maker OpenAI says people should have more faith in his firm and others like it to do the right thing when it comes to AI development, amid rising public concerns about the risks.

"The world should trust that we are going to do the right thing because it's the right thing and we feel the magnitude of this," Sam Altman said on Tuesday during a conference in San Francisco.

However, Altman noted that people were justified in their fears around AI, as the capability of the tools has progressed rapidly.

Speaking in Washington meanwhile, left-wing Senator Bernie Sanders and former Trump adviser Steve Bannon have both called for greater governance of AI.

Altman's comments came during an appearance at an annual conference hosted by software firm Salesforce.

"It doesn't take as much imagination as it used to for [us] to imagine how this could go wrong," he said. "I think the world is right to be afraid of this."

It was the first time he had spoken publicly since a post went viral last week by a researcher who quit the AI firm Anthropic. The researcher claimed AI could "kill all humans" by the end of the decade if left unchecked.

A handful of other AI executives and experts responded by saying they agreed with the assessment, though they didn't explain how they came to their conclusions or how exactly AI could accomplish such a thing.

After Altman's comments, Mark Zuckerberg wrote on X , external every AI firm has the ability and the incentive "to take its own actions" towards safety.

"Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind," the Meta chief executive wrote.

"Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well."

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang said at the same Tuesday conference AI firms should decide if new versions of the technology should be released - and not be managed by outside forces.

"We don't need new laws or regulations," he said, adding there should not be a "false choice" between the speed of innovation and the safety of AI products.

Nvidia is the biggest company in the world by valuation, with its profits having boomed as a result of rampant demand for its hardware.

Huang also argued safety is an "engineering problem" and companies should "take a pause" if they lose confidence in a product.

The recent claims from inside the industry have intensified scrutiny of AI development, prompting Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei to call for the pace of AI development to slow , external and urge governments to regulate the industry.

The post was applauded by Altman, Google's DeepMind...
body.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋表示，人工智能（AI）公司的负责人应该决定是否发布该技术的新版本，以回应人们对人工智能对人类威胁日益增长的担忧。 “我们不需要新的法律或法规，”黄说，并补充说，在人工智能产品的创新速度和安全性之间不应该有“错误的选择”。 按估值计算，英伟达是全球最大的公司，由于对其生产的人工智能计算芯片的需求旺盛，该公司的利润大幅增长。 黄仁勋对人工智能安全的立场与业内人士形成鲜明对比，后者最近表达了对该技术可能消灭人类的担忧。 一位退出人工智能公司 Anthropic 的人工智能研究人员的一篇帖子上周在网上疯传，该帖子声称，如果不加以控制，人工智能可能会在本世纪末杀死所有人类。 其他人工智能高管和专家回应称他们同意。然后，周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁所有人工智能外部发展步伐放缓，并敦促政府监管该行业。 这篇文章得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman、谷歌 DeepMind Demis Hassabis 联合创始人以及社交媒体网站 X 和 AI 助手 Grok 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的赞赏。 然而，一些行业人士表示，这种担忧被夸大了，并被用来炒作该行业。 周二在旧金山举行的销售人员会议上，黄仁勋在谈到人工智能的潜在危险时，将当前的进步称为“一场新的工业革命”，但坚持认为人工智能公司应该从本质上进行自我监管。 他补充说，如果人工智能公司的领导者在任何时候对他们的产品缺乏信心，他们应该选择不发布该产品。 “这是一件非常明显的事情，”黄说。 “尽可能快地跑，但如果任何时候你觉得机构失控了，就停下来。” 让人工智能高管完全自我监管的想法在一些业内人士看来是个坏主意。 Anthropic 高管兼联合创始人杰克·克拉克 (Jack Clark) 周一对 BBC 表示，让人工智能成为一个“完全不受监管的行业”就像“掷骰子，风险巨大”。 由人工智能行业圣人 Yann LeCun 领导的 Logical Intelligence 首席商务官帕特里克·希尔曼 (Patrick Hillman) 周二指出，人们对科技公司做任何真正符合公共利益、外部利益的事情缺乏信心。 “当今美国人唯一可能比华盛顿更不信任的机构是硅谷。我在这两个地方工作和生活过，我向你们保证，你们都受到了这种怀疑，”希尔曼说。 “如果你认为你正在建造的东西是危险的，请告诉我们你准备停止做什么，”他补充道。 OpenAI 的领导者和...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, championed by leaders like Jensen Huang, brings immense praise and influence. Yet, as the technology's potential impact grows, so does the scrutiny. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person is tested by the praise they receive. The challenge for innovators is to temper ambition with wisdom and responsibility, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，在黄仁勋等领导者的推动下，带来了巨大的赞誉和影响力。然而，随着这项技术潜在影响的扩大，审查也随之增加。箴言27:21提醒我们，人受到的试炼在于他所受的称赞。创新者面临的挑战是将雄心与智慧和责任相结合，确保追求进步不会超越伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Inquiry's new light on 'complete failure' around Lucy Letby murders: Here's what we know
title.zh: 关于露西·莱特比谋杀案的“完全失败”的调查新发现：我们所知道的

summary.en: A public inquiry in the United Kingdom concluded that hospital managers could have prevented nurse Lucy Letby from killing more babies if they had taken action against her sooner. Letby is serving a life sentence for murdering seven newborns and attempting to murder eight more between 2015 and 2016. She maintains her...
summary.zh: 英国一项公开调查得出结论，如果医院管理人员早些对护士露西·莱特比采取行动，本可以阻止她杀死更多婴儿。莱特比因在2015年至2016年间谋杀七名新生儿并企图谋杀另外八名而被判处无期徒刑。她坚称自己无罪，并有一个宣传活动认为她遭受了司法不公。

body.en:
A public inquiry in the United Kingdom concluded on Tuesday that hospital managers could have prevented nurse Lucy Letby from killing more babies in her care had they taken action against her sooner.

Letby is serving life in jail after being found guilty of murdering seven newborns and attempting to murder eight more between June 2015 and June 2016 while working at the Countess of Chester Hospital in northern England.

She has always maintained her innocence, and in recent years there has been a growing campaign arguing she was a victim of a miscarriage of justice.

Here are details about her, the controversy around her convictions and the public inquiry.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Letby, 36, was born in Hereford in central England. She completed a nursing degree at Chester University in north-west England, and after qualifying, she began working in the neonatal unit of the city's Countess of Chester Hospital.

Over 18 months from January 2015, there was a significant rise in the number of babies dying and suffering serious collapses at the neonatal unit.

Senior doctors became worried as many of the babies had deteriorated suddenly and unexpectedly, and then did not respond to appropriate resuscitation.

Other babies, who suddenly collapsed and did not die, recovered, with both their collapse and recovery defying usual medical norms.

The police and medical experts were called in and, as they looked for a cause, they eventually focused on one common factor: Lucy Letby.

She was first arrested in July 2018, again in June 2019 and a third time in November 2020, when she was charged with murdering seven babies and attempting to kill another 10 between June 2015 and July 2016.

Prosecutors said Letby attacked 17 babies who had been on the ward. Some she was said to have poisoned with insulin. Mostly she was accused of injecting air into their bloodstream or stomachs, or giving them excessive milk.

The victims included twins and triplets, and in one case, she killed two siblings on consecutive days. The youngest baby she murdered was just a day old. The oldest was 11 weeks old, a baby girl whom she attacked four times before she died.

Although the babies had been born prematurely, some were regarded as being in reasonable or good condition before they suddenly deteriorated, mainly during night shifts when Letby was working.

Letby attacked a number of the babies shortly after their parents had left their bedside, prosecutors said.

Police said she had kept medical records at her home with reference to some of the babies involved and had also carried out social media searches for their parents and families.

She denied any wrongdoing and...
body.zh: 英国的一项公开调查周二得出结论，如果医院管理人员早点对护士露西·莱比采取行动，他们本可以阻止她杀害更多她照顾的婴儿。 莱比在英格兰北部切斯特伯爵夫人医院工作期间，于 2015 年 6 月至 2016 年 6 月期间谋杀了 7 名新生儿，并试图谋杀另外 8 名新生儿，被判终身监禁，目前正在监狱服刑。 她一直坚称自己是清白的，近年来，越来越多的运动认为她是误判的受害者。 以下是有关她的详细信息、围绕她的定罪的争议以及公众调查。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 36 岁的莱特比出生于英格兰中部赫里福德。她在英格兰西北部的切斯特大学完成了护理学位，取得资格后，她开始在该市切斯特伯爵夫人医院的新生儿科工作。 自 2015 年 1 月起的 18 个月内，新生儿病房死亡和严重虚脱的婴儿数量显着增加。 高级医生开始担心，因为许多婴儿的病情突然出人意料地恶化，然后对适当的复苏没有反应。 其他突然倒下但没有死亡的婴儿却康复了，他们的倒下和恢复都违背了通常的医学规范。 警察和医学专家被请来，在寻找原因时，他们最终集中在一个共同因素上：露西·莱比。 她于 2018 年 7 月首次被捕，2019 年 6 月再次被捕，2020 年 11 月第三次被捕，当时她被指控在 2015 年 6 月至 2016 年 7 月期间谋杀 7 名婴儿并试图杀害另外 10 名婴儿。 检察官称，莱比袭击了病房里的 17 名婴儿。据说有些人是她用胰岛素中毒的。大多数情况下，她被指控向他们的血液或胃中注入空气，或者给他们过量的牛奶。 受害者包括双胞胎和三胞胎，在一个案件中，她连续几天杀死了两个兄弟姐妹。她谋杀的最小的婴儿才出生一天。最大的一个是11周大的女婴，她在死前曾袭击过四次。 尽管这些婴儿是早产儿，但有些婴儿在突然恶化之前被认为状况良好或良好，主要是在莱比工作的夜班期间。 检察官称，在父母离开床边后不久，莱比就袭击了一些婴儿。 警方表示，她在家中保存了一些涉案婴儿的医疗记录，并在社交媒体上搜索了他们的父母和家人。 她否认有任何不当行为，并且...

reflection.en: The inquiry's findings point to a tragic failure of oversight, where inaction by hospital managers allowed a predator to continue harming innocent children. This underscores the profound responsibility of those in positions of authority to act decisively to protect the vulnerable, as mandated by Yahweh's call for justice and righteousness.
reflection.zh: 调查结果揭示了监管上的悲剧性失误，医院管理人员的不作为让一名施害者得以继续伤害无辜的儿童。这凸显了掌权者保护弱势群体的重大责任，正如雅伟呼吁公正和公义所要求的。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Trump blasts 'horrible' Supreme Court decision after it blocks plan to restrict mail-in ballots
title.zh: 特朗普抨击最高法院阻止其限制邮寄选票的计划

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has sharply criticized the Supreme Court after it blocked his executive order aimed at restricting mail-in ballots. Democrats lauded the decision, calling the order "flagrantly unconstitutional." Trump expressed disappointment, suggesting the justices he appointed were not acting as he...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在最高法院阻止其限制邮寄选票的行政命令后，严厉批评了最高法院。民主党人称赞该裁决，称该命令“明显违宪”。特朗普对结果表示失望，并暗示他任命的法官并未如他所愿行事。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump strongly criticised the nation's Supreme Court on Tuesday after it blocked his plan to restrict mail-in ballots, launching a rare and blistering attack on the justices he hand-picked in his first term.

Trump accused the court of allowing itself to be cowed by Democrats following the ruling, which comes as a blow to Republican hopes of keeping control of Congress in November's midterm elections.

"These are not the people I interviewed to serve on the United States Supreme Court, they are merely a shell of their original selves," Trump said on his Truth Social network.

Trump appointed three Supreme Court justices in his first term — Amy Coney Barrett, Brett Kavanaugh and Neil Gorsuch — giving the court a conservative supermajority.

But in his lengthy social media diatribe, the 80-year-old Republican now blamed them for some of the most "destructive, hurtful, and damaging decisions in our Country's history".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The Supreme Court has really let our Country down! Certain Justices are petrified of these crazed and depraved Democrats, and are totally unable to show the courage necessary to save our America," he said.

US attorney-general Todd Blanche — who was formerly Trump's personal lawyer during a string of civil and criminal cases — defended the president's attack on the judiciary.

"He is very frustrated," Blanche told reporters at a press conference in the White House Rose Garden. "He has every right, and indeed he should communicate his concerns with the Supreme Court whenever he has them."

Blanche added that the Trump administration could continue to pursue mail-in voting changes despite the court ruling.

Trump signed an executive order in March requiring the compilation of lists of eligible voters and requiring the US Postal Service to deliver ballots only to voters who are on the lists.

He says without evidence that mail-in ballots are vulnerable to fraud, falsely blaming them for his 2020 election loss to Joe Biden.

But his plan faced multiple challenges and the Supreme Court on Monday denied Trump's request to lift an order halting it.

Kavanaugh, in a concurring opinion with the majority, said Trump's plan may ultimately be legal in the long run, but "state and local election officials do not have sufficient time to reasonably implement the rule before the elections".

Only two of the six conservative justices on the nine-member panel offered a dissent.

"It is not easy for me to write this criticism of the United States Supreme Court — it will likely cost me dearly for years to come — but I feel it my obligation and duty,...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二强烈批评美国最高法院，因为最高法院阻止了他限制邮寄选票的计划，对他在第一个任期内亲自挑选的法官发起了罕见的猛烈攻击。 特朗普指责法院在裁决后让自己被民主党吓倒，这对共和党在 11 月中期选举中保持对国会控制权的希望是一个打击。 特朗普在他的真相社交网络上说：“这些人不是我采访的在美国最高法院任职的人，他们只是原始自我的外壳。” 特朗普在第一个任期内任命了三名最高法院法官——艾米·科尼·巴雷特、布雷特·卡瓦诺和尼尔·戈萨奇——让保守派在最高法院占据绝对多数。 但这位 80 岁的共和党人在他冗长的社交媒体谩骂中指责他们做出了一些“我们国家历史上最具破坏性、伤害性和破坏性的决定”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “最高法院真的让我们的国家失望了！某些法官被这些疯狂和堕落的民主党人吓呆了，完全无法表现出拯救我们美国所需的勇气，”他说。 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）曾在一系列民事和刑事案件中担任特朗普的私人律师，为总统对司法机构的攻击进行了辩护。 “他非常沮丧，”布兰奇在白宫玫瑰园举行的新闻发布会上告诉记者。 “他有一切权利，事实上，只要他有疑问，他就应该向最高法院表达他的担忧。” 布兰奇补充说，尽管法院做出了裁决，特朗普政府仍可能继续寻求邮寄投票的改变。 特朗普于三月份签署了一项行政命令，要求编制合格选民名单，并要求美国邮政服务仅向名单上的选民投递选票。 他表示，在没有证据的情况下，邮寄选票很容易受到欺诈，并错误地指责邮寄选票是他在 2020 年选举中输给乔·拜登的原因。 但他的计划面临多重挑战，最高法院周一驳回了特朗普取消停止该计划的命令的请求。 卡瓦诺与多数人意见一致，他表示，从长远来看，特朗普的计划最终可能是合法的，但“州和地方选举官员没有足够的时间在选举前合理执行该规则”。 在九名成员组成的小组中，六名保守派法官中只有两名提出异议。 “对我来说，写这篇对美国最高法院的批评并不容易——这可能会让我在未来几年付出高昂的代价——但我觉得这是我的义务和责任，……

reflection.en: When leaders clash with the judiciary, it can reveal a tension between political aims and the rule of law. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that "Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people." True leadership is characterized by integrity and justice, even when decisions are unpopular or challenge personal agendas.
reflection.zh: 当领导人与司法部门发生冲突时，可能会暴露出政治目标与法治之间的紧张关系。《箴言》16:12 提醒我们：“王凭公义治国，能以公义治国，但凭公义治国，能以公义治国。”真正的领导力是以正直和公正为特征的，即使在决定不受欢迎或挑战个人议程时也是如此。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Four more acts quit Ed Sheeran tour as singer says Macklemore decision 'was not mine'
title.zh: 四组艺人退出艾德·希兰巡演，歌手称麦克尔莫尔的决定“非我所愿”

summary.en: Several acts have now followed the US rapper out the door after his onstage comments led to him being dropped from Sheeran's tour.
summary.zh: 在美国说唱歌手麦克尔莫尔因在舞台上的言论被取消巡演资格后，又有几组艺人跟随他退出了演出。

body.en:
Four supporting acts have quit Ed Sheeran's tour after the rapper Macklemore was removed for pro-Palestinian comments he made during a concert in New Jersey.

Hours after Sheeran posted on social media about Macklemore's removal and attributed the decision to the tour's promoters, Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, the Danish band Lukas Graham, and Finneas posted on Instagram that they would withdraw from Sheeran's tour.

Rowe was one of Macklemore's replacements for Sheeran's remaining US dates, while Beoga was serving as Sheeran's touring band. Finneas, who is Billie Eilish's brother and musical collaborator, was due to tour with Sheeran in South America later this year.

Rowe and Beoga each cited their country's history in their statements explaining their decision.

"We are Irish people who understand colonialism. As founding members of the Irish Artists for Palestine movement, we are committed activists for justice and will continue to be," Beoga said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"But as Irish people we know all too well about genocide, forced famine and violent occupation," he said, saying he could not "stand by and allow billionaires to use their position of power to silence the rightful voices of those who speak up".

Finneas, who has publicly advocated for Palestinians in the past, reiterated his support.

Lukas Graham, meanwhile, expressed gratitude toward Sheeran and called it "a difficult decision".

"Money doesn't give you the right to own the conversation. Nobody's bank balance should decide who gets to speak or which suffering we're allowed to acknowledge," the band posted, seemingly referring to billionaire Robert Kraft's role in Macklemore's removal from the tour.

Sheeran weighed in on Macklemore being dropped as his opening act after the rapper made pro-Palestinian comments onstage during their tour, saying the decision was made by the promoters alone. The British singer also said he refused to be drawn into a public discussion about the war in Gaza.

"Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter's decision, it was not mine," Sheeran wrote on Instagram on Tuesday. "I would never let down the fans who had made plans, nor would I abandon the touring crew and the other support acts and musicians who rely on me for work and to make a living."

Sheeran's statement came a day after Macklemore said he was kicked off the Loop Tour after exclaiming "Free Palestine!" during the 5 September date at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium while introducing his protest song Hind's Hall.

title.en: Criticism of LGBTQ+ raids in Turkey is growing
title.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+的突袭引发日益增长的批评

summary.en: Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations and also from Brussels.
summary.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+人士的数次突袭和逮捕行动，已引发了土耳其国内众多组织以及来自布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。

body.en:
Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations — and also from Brussels.

During weekend  raids targeting LGBTQ+ activists and organizations in Turkey , several people were arrested and many social media accounts were blocked. The Turkish government's actions have drawn sharp criticism from across the country and abroad.

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan had announced the operation as part of the "Decade of Family and Population" scheme, a national strategy proclaimed in May 2025 that was to counter the drastic decline in the country's birth rate and strengthen the traditional, conservative family view.

Istanbul saw renewed demonstrations on Tuesday, with LGBTQ+ associations emphasizing in a joint declaration that it wasn't a crime to set up an association and advocate for rights.

"Freedom of assembly, freedom of opinion, protection of privacy and presumption of innocence apply to LGBTQ+ people as well," the declaration stated.

The LGBTQ+ community also received support from the women's movement, with 120 women's rights organizations signing a joint declaration in which they criticized authoritarianism in Turkey.

"As women, we stand against the operations carried out in the name of 'keeping the family safe.' We know that the repression of our bodies, our lives, our identities and our right to organize is part of the same authoritarian politics . Being [LGBTQ+] is not a crime! Organizing as [LGBTQ+] people is not a crime!"

The government is trying to criminalize the LGBTQ+ community, says Yildiz Taghizade of Women for Women's Human Rights (WWHR), an organization that co-signed the declaration. This criminalization did not just start with the operations of the past few days, but had already been going on for a few years, according to Taghizade.

"The aim is not only to target LGBTQ+ people, but to practically ban the LGBTQ+ community from engaging in politics, getting organized, claiming rights and showing presence in the public sphere," Taghizade said.

It was no coincidence that the operation came with the slogan "My family is safe." 

"The government is trying to justify its actions by invoking the protection of families and children, but this narrative doesn't work. Because when we look at Turkey today and what is actually a factor of uncertainty for families, we come across very concrete issues such as poverty, the  housing crisis, unemployment, care work [caring for and tending to relatives, the ed.]  passed on to women, and male violence against women ," Taghizade said.

Other organizations also criticized the government's actions. The Turkish Medical Association (TTB)...
body.zh: 土耳其对 LGBTQ+ 人士的多次突袭和逮捕引发了众多土耳其组织以及布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。 周末，土耳其发生了针对 LGBTQ+ 活动人士和组织的突袭行动。土耳其当局逮捕了数人，许多社交媒体账户被封锁。土耳其政府的行为引起了全国各地以及布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。 土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安宣布这项手术是“家庭与人口十年”计划的一部分，该计划于 2025 年 5 月宣布，旨在应对该国出生率的急剧下降，并强化土耳其传统、保守的家庭观。 周二，伊斯坦布尔再次爆发示威活动。土耳其LGBTQ+协会在一份联合声明中强调，成立协会并倡导权利并不是犯罪。 声明指出：“集会自由、言论自由、隐私保护和无罪推定也适用于 LGBTQ+ 人群。” LGBTQ+ 群体也得到了妇女运动的支持。 120个妇女权利组织签署了一份联合声明，批评土耳其的独裁主义。 “作为女性，我们反对以‘保护家庭安全’的名义进行的手术。 我们知道，对我们的身体、我们的生活、我们的身份和我们的组织权利的镇压也是独裁政治的一部分。成为 [LGBTQ+] 并不是犯罪！ [LGBTQ+] 人士组织起来并不是犯罪！”这些组织表示。 共同签署该宣言的妇女促进妇女人权组织 (WWHR) 的 Yildiz Taghizade 表示，政府正试图将 LGBTQ+ 群体定为犯罪。塔吉扎德表示，这种刑事定罪不仅是从过去几天的行动开始的，而且已经持续了几年。 塔吉扎德说：“其目的不仅是针对 LGBTQ+ 人群，而且实际上是禁止 LGBTQ+ 群体参与政治、组织起来、主张权利以及在公共领域露面。” 这次行动的口号是“我的家人很安全”，这并非巧合。 塔吉扎德说：“政府试图通过保护家庭和儿童来证明其行动的合理性，但这种说法是行不通的。因为当我们审视今天的土耳其，以及实际上对家庭来说是一个不确定因素时，我们会遇到非常具体的问题，例如贫困、住房危机、失业、护理工作（照顾和照料亲戚，编辑）转嫁到女性身上，以及男性对女性的暴力，”塔吉扎德说。 其他组织也批评政府...

reflection.en: Raids and arrests targeting LGBTQ+ individuals in Turkey, as reported, raise concerns about the rights and safety of marginalized communities. The call for justice and protection for those who may be silenced or vulnerable echoes the ancient wisdom to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves." May we advocate for dignity and fairness for all,...
reflection.zh: 据报道，土耳其针对LGBTQ+人士的突袭和逮捕行动，引发了对边缘化社群权利和安全的担忧。为那些可能被噤声或弱势群体呼吁公正和保护的声音，呼应了古老的智慧：“为不能说话的人说话。” 愿我们都能为所有人的尊严和公平而倡导，尤其是在他们面对压迫之时。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Why do authoritarian regimes target the LGBTQ+ community?
title.zh: 威权政权为何针对LGBTQ+社群？

summary.en: Experts suggest that a recent crackdown on the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey is indicative of a broader regression in rights. While such actions are more severe under authoritarian regimes, the article explores the reasons behind their popularity as a policy for these states, citing examples like raids on gay bars and...
summary.zh: 专家指出，土耳其近期对LGBTQ+社群的打压是更广泛的权利倒退的象征。尽管这种情况在威权政权下更为严重，但文章探讨了为何这类政策在这些国家颇受欢迎，并引用了突袭同性恋酒吧和住所、数百人被捕以及关于保护家庭和儿童的言论作为例证。

body.en:
A recent crackdown on the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey is symptomatic of a wider rights regression, according to experts. It's worse under authoritarian regimes, but why is it such a popular policy for these states?

Raids on gay bars and homes, hundreds of arrests and rhetoric about state responsibility to "protect families and children." Turkey's latest crackdown on LGBTQ+ communities is not such an outlier.

"It's not uncommon, we've seen it before," Dr Koen Slootmaeckers, from the international politics department at City St George's, University of London, told DW.

"Turkey's been doing this for a while, but it seems like a much higher intensity," Slootmaeckers said. "We've seen it in different places too. I think what we are seeing with the rise of the far right is a crackdown on anything that looks different. It's really about an us versus them narrative and a reinforcing of 'traditional family values.'"

Those values were cited by Turkish Justice Minister Akin Gurlek after the weekend's crackdown: "As per the duty to protect families and children given to the state by the constitution, no criminal organization, abuse network or illegal activity which targets children, youths or families will be tolerated!"

The reference to protecting children from harm is also typical of authoritarian government actions against LGBTQ+ communities on a wider scale, added Slootmaeckers, whose work often focuses on gender and sexuality policy.

"They're trying to bring back discourses around pedophilia and homosexuality being intertwined. It's not always direct but there is a definite tendency."

Sentiments such as those expressed by Gurlek have become increasingly normalized of late, according to a 2026 report from South Africa-based civil rights nonprofit, Civicus.

"Women's and LGBTQI+ people's rights are under the most coordinated and wide-ranging attack in decades," the report reads.

It adds that "The USA has set the global narrative" under President Donald Trump and points to the recent criminalizing of same sex relationships in Burkina Faso and Trinidad and Tobago among its evidence of rights regressions.

While the methods of oppression vary, Slootmaeckers said the underlying reasons are often, at least partly, opportunistic rather than ideological.

"In authoritarian regimes, as we've seen in Hungary and Poland in the past , there is often a tendency when political power becomes threatened to use these issues as an easy way to scapegoat and distract — by claiming that LGBT people are a threat to the social fabric because they challenge family and the future of the nation, so to speak. It's an easy way of creating a scapegoat and often distracting from other crises," he said.

body.zh: 专家表示，土耳其最近对 LGBTQ+ 群体的镇压是更广泛的权利倒退的征兆。在独裁政权下情况更糟，但为什么它在这些国家如此受欢迎？ 对同性恋酒吧和家庭的突袭，数百人被捕，以及有关国家“保护家庭和儿童”责任的言论。 土耳其最近对 LGBTQ+ 群体的镇压并非如此。 伦敦大学圣乔治市国际政治系的科恩·斯洛特梅克斯 (Koen Slootmaeckers) 博士告诉德国之声：“这并不罕见，我们以前见过。” “土耳其这样做已经有一段时间了，但强度似乎要高得多，”斯洛特梅克斯说。 “我们也在不同的地方看到过这种情况。我认为，随着极右翼势力的崛起，我们看到的是对任何看起来不同的事物的镇压。这实际上是关于我们与他们的叙述以及‘传统家庭价值观’的强化。” 土耳其司法部长阿金·古尔莱克在周末镇压行动后引用了这些价值观：“根据宪法赋予国家的保护家庭和儿童的义务，任何针对儿童、青少年或家庭的犯罪组织、虐待网络或非法活动都不会被容忍！” Slootmaeckers 补充道，保护儿童免受伤害也是专制政府针对 LGBTQ+ 社区在更广泛范围内采取的典型行动，他的工作通常侧重于性别和性政策。 “他们试图带回有关恋童癖和同性恋交织在一起的讨论。这并不总是直接的，但有一个明确的趋势。” 根据南非民权非营利组织 Civicus 2026 年的一份报告，古尔莱克所表达的情绪最近变得越来越正常化。 报告写道：“女性和 LGBTQI+ 人群的权利正遭受数十年来最协调、最广泛的攻击。” 报告补充说，在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，“美国已经制定了全球叙事”，并指出布基纳法索和特立尼达和多巴哥最近将同性关系定为刑事犯罪是其权利倒退的证据。 斯洛特梅克斯表示，虽然压迫的方式各不相同，但根本原因往往是（至少部分是）机会主义的，而不是意识形态的。 “在专制政权中，正如我们过去在匈牙利和波兰所看到的那样，当政治权力受到威胁时，往往会出现一种倾向，即利用这些问题作为替罪羊和分散注意力的简单方法——声称 LGBT 人群对社会结构构成威胁，因为他们挑战了家庭和国家的未来。可以这么说。这是制造替罪羊的一种简单方法，并且往往会分散人们对其他危机的注意力，”他说。 土耳其在 49 个国家中排名第 47 位...

reflection.en: The targeting of the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey, characterized by raids and arrests, highlights a disturbing trend where vulnerable groups are scapegoated by authoritarian regimes. Proverbs 29:2 warns that when the wicked rule, people groan, but when the righteous rule, the people rejoice. This passage calls us to pray for leaders who govern with justice...
reflection.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+社群的打压，包括突袭和逮捕，凸显了一个令人不安的趋势：威权政权将弱势群体当作替罪羊。《箴言》29章2节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息；义人掌权，人民就喜乐。” 这段经文呼吁我们为那些以公正和怜悯治理的领袖祈祷，而不是那些播下分裂和恐惧的领袖。

title.en: Saudi Arabia faces hard choices as Houthis gain in Yemen
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯面临艰难抉择，也门胡塞武装步步紧逼

summary.en: Saudi Arabia is experiencing increasing security and economic challenges as it attempts to balance deterrence and diplomacy in its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Houthi attacks have injured approximately 100 people since July, and they have also disrupted oil shipping in a key strait.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在与也门胡塞武装不断升级的冲突中，试图在威慑与外交之间取得平衡，但面临日益严峻的安全和经济挑战。自7月以来，胡塞武装的袭击已造成约100人受伤，并扰乱了关键海峡的石油运输。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia faces growing security and economic problems as it seeks to balance deterrence and diplomacy during its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in neighboring Yemen.

Saudi Arabia is being increasingly affected by the rapidly escalating conflict across its southern border in Yemen , where the Iran-backed Houthis are fighting Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.

Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia injured another 13 people on Monday night  bringing the total number of people injured since the conflict escalated in July to about 100.

In July, the Houthis also blocked Saudi oil shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key waterway that had been serving as an  alternative route for Saudi oil exports amid Iran's blockade of the nearby Strait of Hormuz.

Last week, Saudi Arabia's alternative lifeline for oil export, the East-West pipeline, was allegedly targeted by Iranian proxy militias in Iraq. On Tuesday, officials said that it might take weeks to repair the damage to the pipeline which runs 1,200 kilometers (745 miles) across the country and ends at the port of Yanbu on the Red Sea .

"Riyadh faces a genuine dilemma," Neil Quilliam, associate fellow of the Middle East and North Africa program at the London-based think tank Chatham House, told DW. "The Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is trying to protect both Saudi security and Saudi economic development simultaneously," he said. "The difficulty is that the Houthis are increasingly able to threaten both."

Saudi Arabia has one of the most heavily armed and technologically sophisticated militaries in the Middle East, especially in combat aviation and air defense.

But the country is "reluctant to become drawn back into a costly military campaign in Yemen," Quilliam said.

A Saudi-led military coalition intervened in Yemen in 2015 to support the government's fight against Houthi insurgents. After seven years of intense war between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government, the fighting eased in 2022 with a UN-brokered truce .

The latest Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the Saudi-backed government in Yemen aim to pressure Saudi Arabia to end its air and sea blockades on Houthi-held territory which have not been fully lifted despite the 2022 truce.

"Saudi Arabia is now in a very complicated situation," Sebastian Sons, Middle East observer at the German Middle East Research Center CARPO, said.

"On the one hand, it needs to make it clear to the Houthis that a red line has been crossed and that there must also be a military response , particularly in coordination with Yemen's internationally recognized government.

"But on the other hand, it also needs to keep the lines of communication open in order to get back to the negotiating table and...
body.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在邻国也门与伊朗支持的胡塞武装的冲突不断升级时寻求平衡威慑和外交，因此面临着日益严重的安全和经济问题。 沙特阿拉伯越来越受到也门南部边境迅速升级的冲突的影响，伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在与沙特支持的也门政府军作战。 周一晚上，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击又造成 13 人受伤，使自 7 月份冲突升级以来受伤的总人数达到约 100 人。 7月，胡塞武装还封锁了曼德海峡的沙特石油运输，该海峡是伊朗封锁附近霍尔木兹海峡期间沙特石油出口的替代路线的重要水道。 上周，沙特阿拉伯石油出口的替代生命线——东西方管道据称成为伊拉克境内伊朗代理民兵的袭击目标。周二，官员们表示，修复受损管道可能需要数周时间，该管道全长 1,200 公里（745 英里），横跨全国，终点为红海延布港。 伦敦智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目副研究员尼尔·奎利亚姆告诉德国之声：“利雅得面临着真正的困境。” “沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼正在努力同时保护沙特安全和沙特经济发展，”他说。 “困难在于胡塞武装越来越有能力威胁两者。” 沙特阿拉伯拥有中东地区武装最齐全、技术最先进的军队之一，特别是在作战航空和防空方面。 但奎利亚姆说，该国“不愿卷入也门代价高昂的军事行动”。 2015年，沙特领导的军事联盟介入也门，支持政府打击胡塞叛乱分子。胡塞武装与沙特支持的政府之间经历了七年的激烈战争，2022 年，在联合国斡旋下达成休战，战事有所缓和。 胡塞武装最近对沙特阿拉伯和沙特支持的也门政府发动的袭击旨在迫使沙特阿拉伯结束对胡塞武装控制领土的空中和海上封锁，尽管已于 2022 年停战，但这些封锁尚未完全解除。 德国中东研究中心CARPO中东观察员塞巴斯蒂安·桑斯表示：“沙特阿拉伯现在的局势非常复杂。” “一方面，它需要向胡塞武装明确表示，红线已经被跨越，必须采取军事反应，特别是与也门国际公认的政府协调。 “但另一方面，它也需要保持沟通渠道畅通，以便回到谈判桌......

reflection.en: The escalating conflict in Yemen presents Saudi Arabia with a difficult balancing act between military deterrence and diplomatic engagement. The ongoing hostilities, marked by attacks and disruptions, underscore the persistent challenge of finding a path toward peace when tensions are high. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and lasting...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的升级使沙特阿拉伯在军事威慑与外交斡旋之间面临艰难的平衡。持续的敌对行动，伴随着袭击和破坏，凸显了在高压局势下寻求和平之路的严峻挑战。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和持久的和解。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...

title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
