title.en: Exchange Fund could buy more gold to boost trade
title.zh: 香港考虑动用外汇基金增持黄金以促进贸易

summary.en: Hong Kong is exploring the possibility of using its Exchange Fund to purchase more gold, aiming to stimulate the gold trade and establish the city as a global hub for the precious metal. Chief Executive John Lee indicated that the Hong Kong Monetary Authority is investigating increasing the fund's gold holdings and...
summary.zh: 香港正考虑动用其外汇基金增持黄金，旨在刺激黄金贸易并将该市打造成全球贵金属交易中心。行政长官李家超表示，香港金融管理局正在研究增加基金的黄金持有量并参与本地黄金市场的可能性。

body.en: Hong Kong is considering tapping into the Exchange Fund to buy more gold as part of efforts to boost trade in gold and transform the city into a world trading centre for the precious metal, according to Chief Executive John Lee. The fund serves as the city's de facto sovereign wealth fund and war chest to defend the Hong Kong dollar's peg to the US dollar, totalling HK$134.7 billion in the first six months of this year. In delivering his Policy Address, Lee noted that the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), the city's de facto central bank that manages the fund, is exploring the possibility of raising the Exchange Fund's gold holdings and participating in the local spot and futures market. "It (HKMA) is also considering gradually transferring its physical gold holdings to designated vaults appointed by the Hong Kong Precious Metals Central Clearing Company Limited (PMCC)," Lee added. The PMCC is a government-owned company that previously launched a trial clearing and settlement system for gold in early July. Speaking at the Legislative Council, Lee said the gold clearing and settlement system would start its official operations in the first quarter of next year, adding that a dedicated hotline would also be set up to offer one-stop support for mainland overseas gold traders. Other measures include having the Mandatory Provident Fund (MPF) Schemes Authority, which manages local residents' pension funds, allow for a greater range of MPF investments in gold exchange-traded funds (ETFs). The government will also encourage the sector to set up an industry association for gold and host a flagship event next year, he added. On the broader commodity trading ecosystem, Lee noted the city was storing over 20,000 tonnes of metals at designated local warehouses, with total storage area exceeding 60,000 square metres. This came after the London Metal Exchange (LME) included the SAR in its global warehousing network last year, and approved 15 facilities so far to store metals, such as copper, tin, and zinc. To further transform the city into a global commodity trading hub, Lee said authorities would roll out more tax incentives to attract more traders to set up and expand their businesses in the SAR. "We will implement a half-rate tax concession for commodity trading, we will study tax concessions for gold and commodity trading, we'll foster the establishment of more accredited warehouses," he said, adding that a consultation would be launched next year. He also noted a pilot project for tokenised warehouse-receipt financing would be launched by the city's bourse operator next year. The International Organisation for Mediation (IOMed) will also be encouraged to explore the establishment of a special panel of mediators for commodity trading, he added. Edited by...
body.zh: 行政长官李家超表示，香港正在考虑利用外汇基金购买更多黄金，作为促进黄金贸易并将香港转变为世界贵金属交易中心的努力的一部分。该基金是香港事实上的主权财富基金，也是捍卫港元与美元挂钩的战略基金，今年首六个月的资金总额达1,347亿港元。李在发表施政报告时指出，管理外汇基金的事实上的香港中央银行香港金融管理局（金管局）正在探讨增加外汇基金黄金持有量以及参与本地现货和期货市场的可能性。李补充说：“金管局也在考虑逐步将其实物黄金持有量转移至香港贵金属中央结算有限公司（PMCC）指定的指定金库。” PMCC 是一家国有公司，此前曾于 7 月初试行了黄金清算和结算系统。李在立法会发言时表示，黄金清算及交收系统将于明年第一季正式运作，并会设立专门热线，为内地海外黄金交易商提供一站式支持。其他措施包括让管理本地居民养老基金的强制性公积金（MPF）计划管理局允许更多的强积金投资于黄金交易所交易基金（ETF）。他补充说，政府还将鼓励该行业成立黄金行业协会，并在明年举办旗舰活动。在更广泛的大宗商品交易生态系统方面，李指出，该市在当地指定仓库储存了超过20,000吨金属，总储存面积超过60,000平方米。此前，伦敦金属交易所 (LME) 去年将特别行政区纳入其全球仓储网络，并迄今批准了 15 个设施来储存铜、锡和锌等金属。李说，为了进一步将香港转变为全球大宗商品贸易中心，当局将推出更多税收优惠措施，以吸引更多贸易商在香港设立和扩大业务。他说：“我们将对大宗商品交易实行半税率优惠，我们将研究黄金和大宗商品交易的税收优惠，我们将促进建立更多认可的仓库。”他补充说，明年将启动磋商。他还指出，该市交易所运营商将于明年推出代币化仓单融资试点项目。他补充说，还将鼓励国际调解组织（IOMed）探索建立大宗商品交易特别调解员小组。编辑者...

reflection.en: The news highlights a significant financial strategy being considered by Hong Kong's leadership. As they plan to leverage the Exchange Fund for gold acquisition, it's a moment to reflect on the wisdom of committing such endeavors to divine guidance. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to entrust our work to Yahweh, trusting that our plans will be established...
reflection.zh: 此新闻报道了香港领导层正在考虑的一项重大金融策略。当他们计划利用外汇基金收购黄金时，这是一个反思将此类事业托付于神圣指引之智慧的时刻。《箴言》16:3鼓励我们将工作交托给雅伟，并相信我们的计划将因祂的恩惠而得以确立。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Policy Address 2026: Hong Kong to standardise cigarette pack designs in bid to discourage smoking
title.zh: 香港将于2026年底推行香烟包装设计标准化以遏制吸烟

summary.en: Hong Kong's leader, John Lee, announced that starting from the end of next year, all cigarette packs will feature standardized designs. This measure, recommended by the World Health Organization, aims to discourage smoking by removing brand logos and colorful designs, replacing them with plain packaging.
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超宣布，从明年年底开始，所有香烟包装将采用标准化设计。这项措施得到了世界卫生组织的推荐，旨在通过移除品牌标识和多彩设计，改用纯色包装来遏制吸烟。

body.en: Hong Kong will standardise designs on all cigarette packs starting from the end of next year in a bid to discourage residents from smoking, the city’s leader John Lee has announced. A man smoking on the waterfront promenade at Tsim Sha Tsui on September 5, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee made the announcement during his annual Policy Address on Wednesday, after the government gazetted subsidiary legislation last week that will strip cigarette packs of their designs and replace them with plain packaging. In a press release last Friday, the government said the measure was recommended by the World Health Organization. “Plain packaging will remove brand logos, various colours and the decorative elements including slogans and signs on the packaging, fundamentally undermining the brand effect,” the press release stated. It added that plain packaging would direct consumers’ attention to the health warnings printed on the cigarette packs. The government will begin rolling out the standardised packaging from March next year, with a nine-month transition period before the measure is fully enforced on December 1, 2027. The buffer window is meant to allow retailers time to clear existing stock, authorities said. Chief Executive John Lee delivered his fifth Policy Address and Hong Kong’s first five-year plan on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at the Legislative Council. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Hong Kong has implemented a raft of policies in recent years to deter smoking, including raising taxes on cigarettes and cracking down on alternative smoking products. The smoking rate has declined from 23.3 per cent of residents aged 15 or above in the early 1980s to 8.5 per cent last year, according to the Department of Health.
body.zh: 香港领导人李约翰宣布，香港将从明年底开始标准化所有卷烟包装的设计，以阻止居民吸烟。 2024 年 9 月 5 日，一名男子在尖沙咀海滨长廊吸烟。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李在周三的年度施政报告中宣布了这一消息，此前政府上周在宪报公布了附属立法，该立法将取消香烟包装的设计并以平装取代。政府在上周五的一份新闻稿中表示，这项措施是世界卫生组织建议的。新闻稿称：“平装包装会去除包装上的品牌标志、各种颜色以及标语、标志等装饰元素，从根本上损害品牌效应。”它补充说，平装包装将引导消费者注意印在卷烟包装上的健康警告。政府将从明年 3 月开始推出标准化包装，在该措施于 2027 年 12 月 1 日全面实施之前有 9 个月的过渡期。当局表示，缓冲窗口旨在让零售商有时间清理现有库存。行政长官李家超于 2026 年 9 月 16 日星期三在立法会发表第五份施政报告和香港第一个五年计划。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。近年来，香港实施了一系列遏制吸烟的政策，包括提高卷烟税和打击替代吸烟产品。根据卫生署的数据，15岁或以上居民的吸烟率已从20世纪80年代初的23.3%下降至去年的8.5%。

reflection.en: Hong Kong's government is taking a step to protect public health by standardizing cigarette packaging. This action reflects a commitment to the well-being of its citizens, embodying the principle of acting justly and showing mercy in public policy. It is a deliberate effort to curb a harmful habit for the good of the community.
reflection.zh: 香港政府正通过标准化香烟包装来采取措施保护公众健康。这一举措体现了其对市民福祉的承诺，也体现了在公共政策中秉持公义和怜悯的原则。这是为了社区的福祉而努力遏制有害习惯的刻意之举。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hong Kong court winds up Wang Fuk Court renovation consultant over debt
title.zh: 香港法院因债务问题清盘王福庭翻新工程顾问公司

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has ordered the liquidation of an engineering consultant involved in the HK$336 million renovation of the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court due to an undisclosed debt. The High Court granted the winding-up petition after the company failed to appear or oppose the motion.
summary.zh: 香港法院已下令清盘一家工程顾问公司，该公司负责王福庭（火灾后受损）耗资3.36亿港元的翻新工程，原因是存在未披露的债务。高等法院在公司未能出庭或提出反对后，批准了清盘呈请。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has ordered the winding-up of an engineering consultant behind a HK$336 million (US$42.8 million) renovation project at the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court over an unspecified debt. The High Court on Wednesday granted Tong Yiu-kwok’s application to wind up Will Power Architects after the company neither filed a statement in opposition nor sent a representative to explain its position at the hearing. The court did not disclose Tong’s relationship with the firm or the amount of debt...
body.zh: 香港一家法院已下令将一家工程顾问公司清盘，该工程顾问公司负责在遭受火灾的宏福苑进行价值 3.36 亿港元（合 4,280 万美元）的翻修项目，但债务金额不详。周三，高等法院批准唐耀国清盘Will Power Architects的申请，因为该公司既没有提出反对声明，也没有派出代表在听证会上解释其立场。法院没有透露童与该公司的关系或债务金额......

reflection.en: The legal system is meant to uphold fairness and accountability, but when debt leads to a company's dissolution without explanation, it raises questions about justice. Habakkuk laments a similar breakdown, where the law itself seemed ineffective, leaving the righteous vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 法律体系旨在维护公平和问责，但当债务导致公司在无解释的情况下被清盘时，就会引发对公正的疑问。哈巴谷哀叹类似的崩溃，当时法律本身似乎无效，使义人处于危险之中。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: CE vows reform drive for building-maintenance work
title.zh: 行政长官誓言推动楼宇维修改革

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee has pledged to advance necessary measures for reforming the maintenance of older buildings. This commitment follows a fire at Wang Fuk Court in November that claimed 168 lives, leading to numerous charges against the involved consultancy and contractor, as well as individuals connected to the...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超承诺将推动改革旧楼维修的必要措施。此前，王福庭苑于十一月发生火灾，造成一百六十八人死亡，执法及政府部门已就此向负责进行大型翻新的顾问公司、总承建商以及与悲剧相关的人士提出数百项控罪。李家超在周三的施政报告中指出，政府已推出多项措施以加强规例、执法及启动立法修订，推动改革。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee promised that the government would push forward with measures needed to drive reform in the maintenance of older buildings. Following November's fire at Wang Fuk Court, which took 168 lives, law enforcement and government departments have filed hundreds of charges against the consultancy firm and the main contractor, which were undertaking major renovations at the Tai Po estate when the inferno broke out, as well as individuals linked to the tragedy. Delivering his Policy Address on Wednesday, Lee noted that the government had introduced several steps to strengthen regulations, boost enforcement, and initiate legislative amendments to drive reform. These include a comprehensive smoking ban on construction and renovation sites, enhanced regulation of fire-service installations, equipment and contractors, as well as stricter rules and heavier penalties on professionals and contractors for non-compliance during major building maintenance works. Lee said officials were also studying the possibility of criminalising bid-rigging in major building maintenance works with the aim of submitting a legislative proposal this year. For the first time, tender invitation and evaluation services would be launched to assist property owners in the engagement of consultants and contractors, he added. Towards this end, a list of qualified consultants and contractors who have passed background checks by law-enforcement agencies will, for the first time, be drawn up for owners considering undertaking maintenance projects to choose from. “The government is also looking into feasible options to better assist members of the public in handling matters involving professional knowledge in major building maintenance,” Lee said. He added it would study the findings of an independent committee set up to probe the cause and rapid spread of the Wang Fuk Court fire when it submits its report in October, and the chief executive promised to follow up on its recommendations, implement reforms and announce further details in due course. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李约翰承诺，政府将采取必要措施推动旧建筑维护改革。 11 月宏福苑火灾造成 168 人死亡，执法部门和政府部门已对这家咨询公司和总承包商以及与这场悲剧有关的个人提出了数百项指控。火灾发生时，该公司和总承包商正在大埔庄园进行重大翻修工程。李在周三发表施政报告时指出，政府已采取多项措施来加强监管、加强执法并启动立法修正案以推动改革。其中包括在建筑和装修工地全面禁烟，加强对消防装置、设备和承包商的监管，以及对在大型建筑维修工程中不遵守规定的专业人士和承包商实施更严格的规定和更严厉的处罚。李说，官员们还在研究将大型建筑维修工程中的串通投标定为刑事犯罪的可能性，目标是在今年提交一项立法提案。他补充说，将首次推出招标和评估服务，以协助业主聘请顾问和承包商。为此，将首次制定一份通过执法机构背景调查的合格顾问和承包商名单，供考虑进行维修项目的业主选择。李说：“政府亦正在研究可行的方案，以更好地协助市民处理涉及大型楼宇维修专业知识的事宜。”他补充说，在十月份提交报告时，将研究为调查宏福苑火灾原因和迅速蔓延而成立的独立委员会的调查结果，行政长官承诺跟进其建议，实施改革，并在适当时候公布进一步细节。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The tragic fire at Wang Fuk Court, which resulted in 168 fatalities, underscores the critical need for diligent oversight in building maintenance. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to 'execute justice and righteousness' and 'deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This tragedy serves as a somber reminder of the profound responsibility...
reflection.zh: 王福庭苑发生的致命火灾，造成一百六十八人死亡，凸显了楼宇维修监管的严峻挑战。耶利米书22:3呼吁领导者“施行公平和公义”，并“拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这场悲剧是对领导者确保公民安全福祉的重大责任的沉痛提醒，尤其要关注居住在老旧建筑中的弱势群体。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Major water pipes upgrade set for Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港 major 水管升级

summary.en: Hong Kong's water supply network is slated for significant upgrades over the next decade, with Chief Executive John Lee announcing the phasing out of all cast iron and asbestos cement pipes. The initial phase will focus on replacing pipes in areas with high concentrations of public housing and elderly residents,...
summary.zh: 香港的供水网络将在未来十年内进行重大升级，行政长官李家超宣布将逐步淘汰所有铸铁和石棉水泥水管。初期阶段将重点更换公共房屋和老年居民较多的区域的水管，目标是每年更换350公里的老化水管。

body.en: Hong Kong’s water supply network is set for major upgrades, with all cast iron and asbestos cement pipes to be phased out within the next decade, Chief Executive John Lee announced in his Policy Address on Wednesday. Lee said that during the initial years of the upgrading programme, the government will focus on replacing pipes in areas with higher concentrations of public housing estates and elderly residents. “By adopting a risk-based approach, we will replace or rehabilitate a total of 350 kilometres of aged water mains, at an average rate of 70 kilometres per year, double that for 2026-27,” he said. “We will focus on replacing cast iron and asbestos cement pipes in areas such as Shau Kei Wan, Wong Tai Sin and Kwai Tsing, where there are more public rental housing estates and elderly residents. The target is to have all cast iron and asbestos cement pipes phased out over an estimated 10-year period.” Lee added that the objective is to reduce water pipe bursts and serious leaks by 20 to 30 percent within the first five years. The administration will also collaborate with universities and private enterprises to establish an “Intelligent Water Network Closed-loop Management Chain” featuring real-time monitoring, AI-driven prediction and leak detection. The aim is to roll out the system across the entire water supply network within five years of the smart system's launch. An expert group on waterworks comprising local and overseas specialists will also be established to review the long-term management strategy for the city's water network. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周三在施政报告中宣布，香港的供水网络将进行重大升级，所有铸铁和石棉水泥管道将在未来十年内逐步淘汰。李说，在升级计划的最初几年，政府将重点更换公共屋村和老年人集中地区的管道。他说：“通过采用基于风险的方法，我们将更换或修复总计 350 公里的老化水管，平均每年 70 公里，是 2026-27 年的两倍。” “我们会重点在筲箕湾、黄大仙和葵青等公屋村和长者较多的地区更换铸铁和石棉水泥管道。目标是预计在10年内逐步淘汰所有铸铁和石棉水泥管道。” Lee补充说，目标是在头五年内将水管爆裂和严重泄漏减少20%至30%。还将联合高校、民企等建立实时监测、人工智能预测、泄漏检测的“智慧水网闭环管理链”。目标是在智能系统推出后五年内在整个供水网络中推广该系统。此外，还将成立一个由本地和海外专家组成的水务专家组，以审查该市供水网络的长期管理策略。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's commitment to replacing aging water pipes, with a focus on public housing and elderly residents, reflects a responsible approach to essential infrastructure. This proactive measure ensures the well-being of its most vulnerable citizens, demonstrating a practical application of leadership's duty to provide for the people. This...
reflection.zh: 香港政府承诺更换老化的水管，并优先考虑公共房屋和老年居民，这体现了对基本基础设施负责任的态度。这项积极措施确保了最脆弱市民的福祉，是领导层为人民提供服务的实际体现。 这项举措呼应了古代对统治者“施行公平和公义”（耶利米书 22:3）的要求，确保社区的基本需求得到满足，并且服务于社区的基础设施健全可靠，特别是对于那些可能最受其失效影响的人们。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Policy Address 2026: Hong Kong to relax licensing rules for island guesthouses, develop ‘ticket stub economy’
title.zh: 政策 العنوان2026：香港将放宽岛屿宾馆的许可规定，发展“票根经济”

summary.en: Hong Kong will relax its licensing system for small guesthouses on the territory’s outlying islands, leader John Lee has announced in his annual Policy Address speech. The chief executive said on Wednesday that authorities will waive deed-of-mutual-covenant restrictions prohibiting certain premises from being used as...
summary.zh: 香港将放宽其离岛小型宾馆的许可制度，行政长官李家超在其年度《施政报告》演讲中宣布。行政长官周三表示，当局将豁免禁止某些物业用作宾馆或酒店的契约限制，以批准三层或以下岛屿物业的牌照申请。该政策是李家超在《施政报告》演讲中公布的一系列旨在提振本港旅游业的政府措施的一部分。

body.en: Hong Kong will relax its licensing system for small guesthouses on the territory’s outlying islands, leader John Lee has announced in his annual Policy Address speech. Cheung Chau. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. The chief executive said on Wednesday that authorities will waive deed-of-mutual-covenant restrictions prohibiting certain premises from being used as guesthouses or hotels when approving licence applications for island properties of three storeys or under. The policy is part of a raft of government measures to boost the city’s tourism unveiled in Lee’s Policy Address speech. Industry representatives had expected the policy to increase the number of guesthouses on outlying islands by 50 per cent following policy leaks earlier this week, according to local media reports. Lee also said on Wednesday that Hong Kong will develop a “ticket stub economy,” offering various discounts to visitors attending major events held in the city to encourage them to extend their stay and increase spending. The Hong Kong Tourism Board will connect event organisers with retail, catering, and other tourism-related groups, “fostering a consumption chain that extends from the event venue to the community,” he said in Cantonese. Existing tourism initiatives such as developing the “ yacht economy ” to attract high-net-worth boat owners and promoting Hong Kong as a “Muslim-friendly” travel destination will continue, Lee said, adding that the first phase of renewal works for the nightlife hotspot Lan Kwai Fong will be gradually completed from next month. The Immigration Department will launch a pilot scheme at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port in December, which will use artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology to expedite clearance for drivers and passengers of cross-boundary private vehicles, Lee said. The authorities will also expand a tour guide licensing programme to accredit professionals specialising in in-depth tours on history and culture, Lee added, without specifying a timeline.
body.zh: 香港领导人李家超在年度施政报告中宣布，香港将放宽对香港离岛小型宾馆的发牌制度。长洲.资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。行政长官周三表示，当局在批准三层或以下岛屿物业的牌照申请时，将豁免禁止某些处所用作宾馆或酒店的公契限制。该政策是李光耀施政报告中公布的一系列促进香港旅游业发展的政府措施的一部分。据当地媒体报道，在本周早些时候政策泄露后，行业代表预计该政策将使离岛宾馆数量增加 50%。李周三还表示，香港将发展“票根经济”，为出席香港举办的大型活动的旅客提供各种折扣，以鼓励他们延长逗留时间并增加消费。他用粤语说，香港旅游发展局将把活动主办方与零售、餐饮和其他旅游相关团体联系起来，“培育从活动场地延伸到社区的消费链”。李说，现有的旅游举措，如发展“游艇经济”以吸引高净值船主和推广香港作为“穆斯林友好”旅游目的地等，将继续进行。并补充说，夜生活热点兰桂坊的第一阶段重建工程将于下个月开始逐步完成。李说，入境事务处将于12月在港珠澳大桥香港口岸推出试点计划，利用人工智能和面部识别技术，加快跨境私家车司机和乘客的通关速度。李补充说，当局还将扩大导游许可计划，以对专门从事历史和文化深度旅游的专业人士进行认证，但没有具体说明时间表。

reflection.en: Leaders are called to govern with justice and righteousness, ensuring that policies serve the public good. As Hong Kong relaxes rules for island guesthouses to boost tourism, the underlying principle is how governance can foster economic activity while upholding fairness and order. May leaders always seek wisdom to enact policies that benefit their people...
reflection.zh: 领导者蒙召以公正和正直来治理，确保政策服务于公众利益。香港放宽岛屿宾馆的规定以促进旅游业，其根本原则在于治理如何能在维护公平与秩序的同时促进经济活动。愿领导者永远寻求智慧，制定造福人民并荣耀雅伟的政策。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong court terminates trial after suspect in deadly 1991 hold-up dies of cancer
title.zh: 香港法院因嫌疑人死于癌症而终止审判

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has terminated a trial stemming from a deadly shooting during a botched robbery three decades ago, as the defendant died in custody earlier this week. The High Court discharged a seven-member jury presiding over the trial of Wen Wenye, who allegedly participated in a murder and attempted robbery in...
summary.zh: 香港一家法院已终止了对一起三十年前抢劫案致命枪击事件的审判，因为被告本周早些时候在羁押期间死亡。高等法院周三解散了审理温文业案件的七人陪审团。温文业被指控参与了1991年6月9日在深水埗一家二手商品店“顺发公司”发生的谋杀和抢劫未遂案。温某（62岁）周一下午在羁押期间被送往医院后不治身亡。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has terminated a trial arising from a deadly shooting during a botched robbery three decades ago after the defendant died in custody earlier this week. The High Court on Wednesday discharged a seven-member jury presiding over the trial of Wen Wenye, who allegedly took part in the murder and attempted robbery at Shun Fat Company, a second-hand goods shop in Sham Shui Po, on June 9, 1991. A government statement on Monday said Wen, 62, died in hospital that afternoon after he was...
body.zh: 本周早些时候，被告在羁押期间死亡，香港一家法院终止了对三十年前一起拙劣抢劫中致命枪击事件的审判。高等法院周三解散了负责审讯文文业的七名陪审团，文文业涉嫌参与 1991 年 6 月 9 日在深水埗二手货店顺发公司的谋杀和未遂抢劫案。政府周一发表声明称，文文业现年 62 岁，于当天下午在医院死亡。

reflection.en: Decades after a violent crime, the legal process is halted not by a verdict, but by the simple, inescapable reality of death. Wen Wenye's passing, at 62, serves as a stark reminder that all lives are finite, regardless of the circumstances or the passage of time. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death comes to all, a universal equalizer that brings earthly...
reflection.zh: 暴力犯罪发生数十年后，法律程序的终结并非源于判决，而是源于死亡这一简单而不可避免的现实。温文业的离世，年仅62岁，有力地提醒我们，无论境遇如何或时光流逝，所有生命都是有限的。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死是所有人的结局，它是一位普遍的平等者，为尘世之事划上最终的句号。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Govt target to cut public housing wait to under 4 yrs
title.zh: 政府目标到2030年将公屋轮候时间缩短至四年以下

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive, John Lee, announced a goal to reduce public housing wait times to under four years by 2030. This initiative is part of a five-year plan to increase housing supply, including 30,000 Light Public Housing units, and to eliminate substandard subdivided flats by the same year.
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周三表示，政府目标是在2030年前将公屋轮候时间缩短至四年以下。这是该市首个五年规划的一部分，旨在增加公屋供应，包括3万个光租单位，并于同年解决不合规格的劏房问题。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said on Wednesday the government aims to cut the waiting time for public housing to less than four years by 2030 as he stressed the need to boost overall supply and eradicate substandard subdivided units. With the average wait for public rental housing down to 4.5 years in 2026-27, the goal is to lower it even further thanks to an increase in public housing supply to 196,000 flats in the next five years – including 30,000 Light Public Housing units – according to the city's first five-year blueprint. The government also aims to resolve the issue of substandard subdivided flats by 2030. "We will take an orderly approach to the eradication of poor-quality subdivided units. Implementing the basic housing unit regime will massively increase the supply of public housing that will take forward the long-term housing strategy," Lee said. "We will crack down on the abuse of public housing and speed up the turnover of public housing. We will continue to embrace the spirits of people-centric and care for the community, and respond swiftly to the disadvantaged community's needs." The chief executive said the government plans to utilise public housing resources to help residents move up the housing ladder, while facilitating property ownership among younger people. On longer-term supply, he envisioned public rental housing to account for 40 percent of total supply in the next decade, with subsidised sale flats and private homes each making up 30 percent. The government will also promote the use of smart construction technologies, such as modular integrated construction, to speed up production and increase efficiency. To boost land supply, Lee said the government will make available 2,500 hectares of "spade-ready sites" – those that are ready for development – in the coming decade, of which 1,400 hectares will be ready in the next five years. "We will gradually release the land into the property market so that the market can develop in a healthy manner," he said. And in what's termed a "new mindset" on urban redevelopment, officials will use land in new development areas to support the renewal of old districts. For example, sites in the Northern Metropolis will be reserved for Urban Renewal Authority (URA) projects. The URA will commit at least HK$40 billion for its initiatives in the next five years. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周三表示，政府的目标是到 2030 年将公屋轮候时间缩短至四年以下，他强调需要增加整体供应并消除不合格的劏房。根据该市第一个五年蓝图，到 2026-27 年，公共租赁住房的平均等待时间将缩短至 4.5 年，由于未来五年公共住房供应量将增加到 196,000 套，其中包括 30,000 套轻型公共住房，目标是进一步降低等待时间。政府还计划到2030年解决劣质劏房问题。李说：“我们将有序消除劣质劏房。实施基本住房制度将大幅增加公营住房供应，推动长远住房战略。” “我们将严厉打击公屋滥用行为，加快公屋周转。我们将继续秉持以人为本、关爱社区的精神，迅速回应弱势群体的需求。”行政长官表示，政府计划利用公共住房资源帮助居民提升住房阶梯，同时促进年轻人拥有房产。就长期供应而言，他预计未来十年公屋供应量将占总供应量的40%，资助出售单位和私人住宅各占30%。政府还将推广使用模块化集成建造等智能建筑技术，以加快生产速度并提高效率。李表示，为了增加土地供应，政府将在未来十年内提供2,500公顷“已准备好开发的土地”，其中1,400公顷将在未来五年内准备好。 “我们将逐步向房地产市场释放土地，使市场健康发展。”他说。在所谓的城市重建“新思维”中，官员们将利用新开发区的土地来支持旧区的更新。例如，北部都会区的土地将预留给市区重建局（URA）项目。市建局将在未来五年投入至少 400 亿港元推行各项措施。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The government's pledge to shorten public housing wait times and improve living conditions speaks to the fundamental responsibility of leaders to ensure the well-being of their citizens. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This commitment to providing shelter...
reflection.zh: 政府承诺缩短公屋轮候时间并改善居住条件，体现了领导者保障其公民福祉的基本责任。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”这项提供住所和尊严的承诺，正是对那古老使命的回响。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Five-Year Plan: Hong Kong eyes boost in innovation spending, ratio of doctors to population among other targets
title.zh: 五年规划：香港着眼于增加创新支出、医生人口比例等目标

summary.en: Hong Kong has set a range of goals as part of its first Five-Year Plan in line with China’s, from boosting spending on innovation to increasing the ratio of doctors to the population. Chief Executive John Lee spent around an hour and 20 minutes reading out key points from the plan.
summary.zh: 香港已制定了一系列目标，作为其首个五年规划的一部分，与中国的规划相一致，目标包括增加创新支出和提高医生人口比例。行政长官李家超花了大约一小时二十分钟宣读了该规划的关键要点。

body.en: Hong Kong has set a range of goals as part of its first Five-Year Plan in line with China’s, from boosting spending on innovation to increasing the ratio of doctors to the population. Chief Executive John Lee delivering his fifth Policy Address and Hong Kong’s first five-year plan on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at the Legislative Council. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Chief Executive John Lee spent around an hour and 20 minutes reading out key points from the Five-Year Plan before moving on to the Policy Address. He said the Five-Year Plan had five goals. These include “economic breakthroughs, maintaining Hong Kong’s rising international competitiveness and influence, accelerating the development of the Northern Metropolis, improving social wellbeing, and… integrating into and serving overall national development,” Lee said in Cantonese. This is the first time Hong Kong has developed its own Five-Year Plan to align with the one in China, where the Soviet-inspired initiative provides a development blueprint for the country. As part of the plan, authorities set 22 indicators labelled “anticipatory” or “binding,” adopting the same evaluation framework Beijing uses in its Five-Year Plans. Among the “anticipatory” indicators is an increase in the ratio of total domestic expenditure on innovation activities to GDP from 1.63 per cent in 2024 to three per cent after 2030, as well as an increase in the “value added” of the tourism industry by 40 to 50 per cent. Tourists in Tsim Sha Tsui on December 29, 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The latter figure refers to contributions to the economy by industries – such as the hotel and retail sectors – providing goods and services directly to visitors. Authorities did not set a GDP target for the end of the five years, but said that annual targets will be proposed “in light of prevailing conditions.” Education and health Beyond economic indicators, the government also outlined goals related to diversity in universities, the ratio of medical staff to population, and environmental matters. The city is eyeing a 25 per cent increase in non-local students enrolled in full-time post-secondary education programmes, from 79,800 in the 2024/25 academic year to 100,000 in 2029/30. Authorities hope to boost the ratio of doctors to total population from 2.25 doctors per 1,000 people last year to 2.43 in 2030. They also aim to achieve an “upward trend” in per capita public health expenditure, but have not specified a figure. A doctor working in a public hospital in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. These three indicators were listed as “anticipatory” rather than binding. Environment and development The...
body.zh: 作为与中国一致的第一个五年计划的一部分，香港制定了一系列目标，从增加创新支出到提高医生与人口的比例。行政长官李家超于 2026 年 9 月 16 日星期三在立法会发表第五份施政报告和香港第一个五年计划。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。行政长官李家超用了约一小时二十分钟宣读了五年计划的要点，然后开始宣读《施政报告》。他说，五年计划有五个目标。李说，其中包括“经济突破、保持香港不断提升的国际竞争力和影响力、加快北方都会区发展、改善社会福祉，以及……融入和服务国家发展大局”。这是香港首次制定自己的五年计划，以配合中国的五年计划，受苏联启发的倡议为国家提供了发展蓝图。作为该计划的一部分，当局制定了 22 项标有“预期”或“约束力”的指标，采用了北京在其五年计划中使用的相同评估框架。 “预期”指标包括国内创新活动总支出占GDP的比例从2024年的1.63%增加到2030年后的3%，以及旅游业的“增加值”增加40%至50%。 2025 年 12 月 29 日，游客在尖沙咀。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。后一个数字指的是酒店和零售业等直接向游客提供商品和服务的行业对经济的贡献。当局没有设定五年末的GDP目标，但表示将“根据当前情况”提出年度目标。教育和健康 除了经济指标外，政府还概述了与大学多样性、医务人员与人口的比例以及环境问题相关的目标。该市计划将全日制专上教育课程的非本地学生人数增加 25%，从 2024/25 学年的 79,800 人增至 2029/30 学年的 100,000 人。当局希望到2030年将医生与总人口的比例从去年的每千人2.25名医生提高到2.43名。他们还希望实现人均公共卫生支出的“上升趋势”，但没有具体数字。一名在香港公立医院工作的医生。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这三个指标被列为“预期”而非约束性指标。环境与发展...

reflection.en: Hong Kong's Five-Year Plan outlines ambitious goals for innovation and public services, aiming to improve the lives of its citizens. This focus on governance and societal well-being echoes the ancient call for leaders to administer justice and care for their people, ensuring that public office serves the common good.
reflection.zh: 香港的五年规划为创新和公共服务设定了宏伟目标，旨在改善市民的生活。这种对治理和社会福祉的关注，呼应了古老的呼吁，即领导者应施行公正并关怀其人民，确保公职服务于共同利益。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Policy Address 2026: Hong Kong to expand gov’t-funded national security exhibition
title.zh: 政策声明2026：香港将扩建政府资助的国家安全展览馆

summary.en: Hong Kong will expand its publicly funded National Security Exhibition Gallery to promote the concept of “security brings prosperity,” leader John Lee has said in his annual Policy Address speech. The National Security Exhibition Gallery at the Hong Kong Museum of History has drawn over 1.9 million visitors since its...
summary.zh: 香港领导人李家超在其年度施政报告中表示，香港将扩建政府资助的国家安全展览馆，以推广“安全带来繁荣”的理念。香港历史博物馆的国家安全展览馆自2024年中推出以来，已吸引了超过190万名参观者。

body.en: Hong Kong will expand its publicly funded National Security Exhibition Gallery to promote the concept of “security brings prosperity,” leader John Lee has said in his annual Policy Address speech. People watch a video installation in the Hong Kong Museum of History, on October 1, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The National Security Exhibition Gallery at the Hong Kong Museum of History has drawn over 1.9 million visitors since its launch in mid-2024, Lee said on Wednesday as he delivered his fifth Policy Address speech at the Legislative Council. See also: Hong Kong’s new national security gallery tells different story about unrest than Western media, foreign visitors say “The government will expand the gallery and enrich its content to promote the concept that ‘security brings prosperity,’” he said in Cantonese, without elaborating further. The exhibition, which occupies over 1,100 square metres on the museum’s second floor, currently comprises six areas covering China’s national development and Hong Kong’s 2019 protests and unrest. See also: In Pictures: Museum of History opens revamped ‘Hong Kong Story’ exhibition with new focus on China ‘roots’ Lee said on Wednesday that Hong Kong must establish a “bottom-line mindset” when it comes to safeguarding national security against “hidden threats.” The chief executive adopted Chinese President Xi Jinping’s idea of taking a “holistic approach” to national security and development, saying the two must work in tandem. “High-quality development must be safeguarded by high-level security; in turn, high-level security must be underpinned by high-quality development,” Lee said. Before his Policy Address speech on Wednesday, Lee delivered the city’s first Five-Year Plan speech, during which he pledged to enhance security governance. The government will enhance the role of the top-level Committee for Safeguarding National Security, while rigorously carrying out enforcement of the city’s national security laws, he said. “We will continue to raise civil servants’ self‑awareness of safeguarding national security,” Lee said, “while actively promoting national security knowledge at schools, communities, and enterprises.” Beijing inserted national security legislation directly into Hong Kong’s mini-constitution in June 2020 following a year of pro-democracy protests and unrest. It criminalised subversion, secession, collusion with foreign forces and terrorist acts – broadly defined to include disruption to transport and other infrastructure. The move gave police sweeping new powers and led to hundreds of arrests amid new legal precedents , while dozens of civil society groups disappeared . The authorities say it restored stability and peace to the city, rejecting criticism from trade...
body.zh: 领导人李家超在年度施政报告中表示，香港将扩建公共资助的国家安全展览馆，以推广“安全带来繁荣”的理念。 2024 年 10 月 1 日，人们在香港历史博物馆观看视频装置。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李周三在立法会发表第五次施政报告时表示，香港历史博物馆国家安全展览馆自 2024 年中启用以来，已吸引超过 190 万人次参观。另请参阅：香港新的国家安全画廊讲述的骚乱故事与西方媒体不同，外国游客表示“政府将扩大画廊并丰富其内容，以宣传‘安全带来繁荣’的概念，”他用粤语说道，但没有进一步说明。该展览位于博物馆二楼，占地1100多平方米，目前包括六个区域，涵盖中国国家发展和香港2019年的抗议和骚乱。另请参阅：图文并茂：历史博物馆改版后的“香港故事”展览开幕，新的重点是中国的“根源” 李周三表示，在维护国家安全免受“隐藏威胁”方面，香港必须建立“底线思维”。这位行政长官采纳了中国国家主席习近平对国家安全和发展采取“整体方针”的想法，并表示两者必须协同工作。 “高质量发展必须以高水平安全为保障，高水平安全又必须以高质量发展为支撑。”在周三发表施政报告之前，李光耀发表了香港的第一个五年计划演讲，承诺加强安全治理。他说，政府将强化最高层维护国家安全委员会的作用，同时严格执行香港国家安全法。李说：“我们将继续提高公务员维护国家安全的自我意识，同时积极向学校、社区和企业宣传国家安全知识。”经过一年的民主抗议和骚乱后，北京于 2020 年 6 月将国家安全立法直接纳入香港小宪法。它将颠覆、分裂国家、与外国势力勾结和恐怖主义行为定为刑事犯罪——广义上包括破坏交通和其他基础设施。此举赋予警方全面的新权力，并导致数百人在新的法律先例中被捕，同时数十个民间社会团体消失。当局表示，此举恢复了这座城市的稳定与和平，拒绝了来自贸易的批评……

reflection.en: The expansion of Hong Kong's National Security Exhibition Gallery, framed by the slogan 'security brings prosperity,' prompts reflection on the role of leadership. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness,' a standard against which all governance, including the promotion of security narratives, should be measured. True prosperity is...
reflection.zh: 香港国家安全展览馆的扩建，以“安全带来繁荣”为口号，促使人们反思领导者的角色。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义”，这是衡量所有治理（包括推广安全叙事）的标准。真正的繁荣往往植根于人民的福祉和自由，而不仅仅是国家定义的安全。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...

Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在一部低成本的喜剧冒险片中，童年好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，该片突破了讲故事的界限。由郭嘉熙和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，是对真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红的异想天开的戏仿，其手法充满爱意而非恶意。故事围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes the world of true crime and online influencers, reminding us of the importance of discerning what is worthy of our attention. In a world saturated with sensational stories, Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on whatever is true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, and commendable.
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种有趣的方式讽刺了真实犯罪和网络网红的世界，提醒我们辨别何为值得我们关注的事物的重要性。在一个充斥着耸人听闻的故事的世界里，腓立比书 4:8 呼吁我们将心思意念集中在一切真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Wildfires push endangered Sumatran elephants to brink: Indonesian NGO
title.zh: 野火将苏门答腊象推向灭绝边缘：印尼非政府组织

summary.en: Wildfires are rapidly destroying the habitat of critically endangered Sumatran elephants on the island of Sumatra, pushing them closer to extinction, according to Indonesian conservation group Geopix. The fires have caused widespread haze across the region, with over 4,500 hotspots detected in elephant habitats.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚环保组织Geopix称，野火正在迅速摧毁苏门答腊岛上濒临灭绝的苏门答腊象的栖息地，将其推向灭绝的边缘。大火在该地区造成了广泛的雾霾，在亚洲象的栖息地发现了超过4500个热点。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Critically endangered Sumatran elephants are being pushed closer to the brink as wildfires raze vast swaths of their habitat on the western island of Sumatra, Indonesian conservation group Geopix told AFP on Wednesday.

Indonesia has for weeks been battling fires in parts of Borneo and Sumatra that have blanketed the country, along with neighboring Malaysia and Singapore, with suffocating haze .

Geopix said in a report published Tuesday that more than 4,500 hotspots had been detected in 21 Sumatran elephant habitats between June and early September, threatening one of the world's rarest elephant species.

The World Wildlife Fund estimates that only 2,400 to 2,800 Sumatran elephants remain in the wild.

More than 560,000 hectares (1.4 million acres) burned during the same period, Geopix said in its report.

Hotspots within elephant habitats jumped to more than 2,800 in the first week of September, more than double the roughly 1,300 recorded in August, the NGO said.

Geopix senior wildlife campaigner Annisa Rahmawati described the impact of the fires on Sumatran elephant habitat this year as "brutal."

"Ecologically, fires caused habitat loss, degradation and fragmentation, reducing food and water sources as well as changing the elephants' movement patterns," she said.

Rahmawati said exposure to toxic smoke from the fires could increase physiological stress among the animals.

She warned that shortages in food and water supplies could further dampen the elephants' ability to survive in the wild.

Indonesia regularly battles wildfires during the dry season, which typically runs from July to October, but the blazes this year were worse in part because of the El Niño weather phenomenon.

Experts also blame climate change, decades of forest degradation and slash-and-burn land-clearing practices that have changed the naturally fire-resistant landscape.

The Indonesian government has said more than 202,000 hectares (499,000 acres) of land burned countrywide between January and July.

The Nusantara Atlas project put that at close to 300,000 hectares (741,000 acres) over the same period, and last week estimated the total area affected, including August, was nearly 896,000 hectares (2.2 million acres).
